definition_zh: 展开；铺开；传播；蔓延；涂抹；摊开
definition_en: to open something out so that it covers a larger area, or to reach or make something reach a wider area or more people
core_image: 一张折起的纸被双手缓缓摊平，边缘不断向外扩大
scene: 清晨的草地上，野餐布被慢慢抖开摊平。They spread a large blanket over the wet grass and sat down to eat.
sceneCN: 这里 spread 是「铺开、展开」（第 1 个义项：把折叠之物摊平扩大面积）；句意为他们把一大块毯子铺在湿草地上坐下吃东西。

pos.zh: 动词：展开；铺开；传播；蔓延；涂抹
名词：传播；蔓延；幅度；涂抹酱

derivatives.zh: 由 wide 加本词构成，义为「广泛流传的；普遍的」
由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「扩展；蔓延（过程）」
由 out- 加本词构成，义为「向外张开的；铺开的」

senses.title: To open out and cover a larger area
senses.definition: to unfold or arrange something so that it covers a wider surface
senses.definitionCN: 把折叠或收拢的东西打开，使其覆盖更大的表面
senses.example: She spread the map across the table.
senses.exampleCN: 她把地图摊在桌子上。
senses.why: The core image is a folded thing whose edges move outward once the hands let it open.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是折叠之物一旦被放开，边缘便向外扩展。

senses.title: To become known to more people
senses.definition: to make news, information, or stories reach more and more people
senses.definitionCN: 使消息、信息或故事被越来越多的人知道
senses.example: The news of the victory spread quickly through the town.
senses.exampleCN: 胜利的消息很快传遍了小镇。
senses.why: Information behaves like an opened cloth: from one mouth it extends outward to many ears.
senses.whyCN: 信息像展开的布：从一张嘴出发，向外延伸到许多耳朵。

senses.title: To extend over a larger area
senses.definition: to grow or reach gradually over a larger area or among more things
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐生长或影响到更大的范围或更多的事物
senses.example: The fire spread from the kitchen to the bedrooms.
senses.exampleCN: 大火从厨房蔓延到了卧室。
senses.why: Fire, disease, and water all grow outward like a cloth being unrolled.
senses.whyCN: 火、疾病与水都像被展开的布一样向外生长。

senses.title: To put a soft layer onto a surface
senses.definition: to put a soft substance such as butter or jam onto a surface in a thin layer
senses.definitionCN: 把黄油、果酱等软性物质薄薄地涂在表面上
senses.example: He spread jam on his toast before breakfast.
senses.exampleCN: 早餐前他把果酱涂在吐司上。
senses.why: The soft substance is pushed until it covers the whole surface, just like the opened cloth.
senses.whyCN: 软性物质被推开直到盖住整个表面，正如摊开的布。

senses.title: To stretch out body parts or fingers
senses.definition: to move the arms, legs, or fingers far apart from each other
senses.definitionCN: 把双臂、双腿或手指彼此分开伸展开
senses.example: The eagle spread its wings and lifted into the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 鹰展开双翅，乘风而起。
senses.why: Limbs are like folded cloth: opening them widens the space the body covers.
senses.whyCN: 肢体像折叠的布：张开便扩大身体覆盖的空间。

senses.title: The range between two amounts
senses.definition: the difference or range between two prices, rates, or amounts
senses.definitionCN: 两个价格、比率或数额之间的差距或范围
senses.example: The spread between the two prices narrowed this month.
senses.exampleCN: 本月两个价格之间的差距缩小了。
senses.why: The opened cloth stretches from one edge to the other; that whole width is the gap.
senses.whyCN: 摊开的布从一边延到另一边，这整个宽度就是差距。

senses.title: A soft food for spreading
senses.definition: a soft food such as butter or jam that can be put onto bread
senses.definitionCN: 可以涂在面包上的黄油、果酱等软性食物
senses.example: This cheese spread goes well with crackers.
senses.exampleCN: 这种奶酪酱和饼干很配。
senses.why: The thing that gets spread becomes a name for itself: a food made to cover bread.
senses.whyCN: 被涂抹的东西反过来成为自己的名称：专为覆盖面包而做的食物。

senses.title: A large meal or wide layout
senses.titleCN: 丰盛的一餐；铺开的一整片
senses.definition: a large meal with many dishes, or a wide area covered by something laid out
senses.definitionCN: 摆满菜肴的丰盛一餐，或铺开占据一大片的布置
senses.example: They laid out a huge spread of dishes for the guests.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为客人摆了一大桌丰盛的菜肴。
senses.why: Many dishes laid wide across a table look like a cloth spread over it.
senses.whyCN: 许多菜肴铺满桌面，看上去就像铺开的一块桌布。

intro.en: Spread is an Old English word whose history is about pushing edges outward, and its old past forms were kept unchanged to this day.
intro.cn: spread 是古英语词汇，历史围绕「把边缘向外推」展开，其古老的过去式形式一直保留到今天未变。

items.en: A root meaning "to split, break apart" is generally reconstructed, though the exact form is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为其词根表示「劈开、分开」；确切形式来源不确定。

items.en: West Germanic formed a strong verb meaning "to stretch out, extend".
items.cn: 西日耳曼语形成了一个强变化动词，表示「伸展、扩展」。

items.en: Old English tosprædan and sprædan meant "to spread out", already used for cloth, fire, and wings.
items.cn: 古英语 tosprædan 与 sprædan 意为「摊开」，已用于布、火与翅膀。

items.en: The verb spread stayed strong, keeping the same form for past and past participle.
items.cn: 中古英语 spread 保持强变化，过去式与过去分词同形。

items.en: The senses widened from cloth and fire to news, prices, food, and a rich meal.
items.cn: 词义从布与火扩展到消息、价格、食物与盛宴。

note.en: Spread belongs to a family of extend-words, and it also looks like the unrelated word bread.
note.cn: spread 属于「扩展」词族，同时与不相关的 bread 拼写相近。

entries.definition: a common food made from flour, water, and yeast
entries.definitionCN: 面包；与 spread 只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a thin string used in sewing
entries.definitionCN: 线；拼写相近但词源不同，义为缝纫用的细线

entries.definition: to walk or step on something
entries.definitionCN: 踩；行走；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: to make something longer or larger in area
entries.definitionCN: 延伸；扩展，强调长度或范围变大

entries.definition: to become larger in size or amount
entries.definitionCN: 膨胀；扩大，强调体积或规模增大

entries.definition: to throw things in different directions over an area
entries.definitionCN: 撒开；散布，强调向四处分散

entries.definition: to spread ideas or reproduce plants formally
entries.definitionCN: 传播（思想）；繁殖（植物），较正式用语

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember spread through its real forms and uses.
normalIntro.cn: 五条借助真实构词与用法记住 spread 的方法。

normal.en: s- + read: a folded letter is spread open to be read.
normal.cn: 联想 s + read：折叠的信被展开来读，正好是「摊开」。

normal.en: spread, spread, spread: all three verb forms are the same word.
normal.cn: spread 的原形、过去式、过去分词完全同形，记一个等于记三个。

normal.en: wide + spread = widespread, the common adjective for "found everywhere".
normal.cn: wide + spread 构成 widespread「普遍的」，反过来帮记 spread 的本义。

normal.en: Butter is spread on bread; the rhyme spread–bread links the two actions.
normal.cn: 黄油涂（spread）在面包（bread）上，两个词押韵，画面成对出现。

normal.en: News spreads like fire spreads: outward from one point.
normal.cn: 消息像火一样蔓延（spread）：都从一个点向外扩张。

abstract.en: Picture a blanket being shaken out until its corners reach the horizon.
abstract.cn: 想象一条毯子被抖开，四角一直延展到地平线。

abstract.en: Imagine ripples on a pond spreading outward after one stone drops.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗石子落水后涟漪不断向外扩散。

abstract.en: See arms opening wide: whatever is held between them grows wider.
abstract.cn: 看见双臂大大张开：两手之间容纳的东西随之变宽。

examples.en: The villagers spread the harvest out on the ground to dry in the sun.
examples.cn: 村民把收成摊开在地上晒太阳。

examples.en: Rumors can spread faster than any official announcement.
examples.cn: 谣言可能比任何官方通告传播得更快。

examples.en: She spread a thin layer of honey over the warm toast.
examples.cn: 她在温热的吐司上薄薄涂了一层蜂蜜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯普瑞德」——像「撕铺」开来：斯的一声把布铺满四地，铺得又快又开。

root: 古英语 sprædan「伸展、铺开」，与较低可信度的原始印欧语「劈开、分开」词根相关；一般认为属西日耳曼强变化动词，此构词路径为通常看法，确切词根来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Spread moves from the physical unfolding of cloth outward to news, fire, butter, prices, and even a rich meal.
sensesIntro.cn: spread 从布的物理摊开出发，延伸到消息、火势、黄油、价格差距乃至一桌盛宴。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: edges pushed outward until something covers a wider space
core.cn: 核心意象：边缘被向外推，使某物覆盖更宽的空间

branches.en: cloth and wings unfold to cover space
branches.cn: 布与翅膀展开以覆盖空间

branches.en: news and fire extend outward
a soft layer put onto a surface and the food itself
branches.cn: 涂在表面的软层与这种食物本身

branches.en: the width between two measured points
many dishes laid out wide like a cloth
branches.cn: 像桌布一样铺满一桌的菜肴

intro.en: Spread is a single old verb, so its family is built by adding whole words and prefixes around it.
intro.cn: spread 是单一古老动词，其词族靠在周围加前缀与整词构成。

latinIntro.en: Spread is Germanic, not Latin; there are no Latin relatives, and the useful relatives are Germanic compounds.
latinIntro.cn: spread 属日耳曼语源而非拉丁语源；没有拉丁同族词，有用的同族词是日耳曼复合词。

items.meaning: found or happening over a large area
items.example: The flood caused widespread damage across the valley.
items.exampleCN: 洪水在山谷里造成了大范围破坏。

items.example: The bird sat with outspread wings.
items.exampleCN: 鸟儿张着翅膀坐着。

items.meaning: the act or process of spreading
items.example: The spreading of the stain stopped once the cloth dried.
items.exampleCN: 布干之后污渍便不再扩散。

items.meaning: a soft food made for putting on bread
items.example: They bought a jar of butter spread for breakfast.
items.exampleCN: 他们买了一罐早餐用的黄油酱。

items.example: Cheese spread is popular at children's parties.
items.exampleCN: 奶酪酱在儿童聚会上很受欢迎。

items.meaning: a thing that spreads, as in a spreading tool
items.example: Use a knife as a spreader for the jam.
items.exampleCN: 用刀当抹刀来抹果酱。

items.meaning: a surface or layer spread over an area
items.example: A bed of sand was spread under the tiles.
items.exampleCN: 瓦片下面铺了一层沙。

items.meaning: a grid of rows and columns for calculating
items.meaningCN: 电子表格，源自铺开的账页
items.example: She entered all the costs into a spreadsheet.
items.exampleCN: 她把所有成本输入了电子表格。

derivatives.zh: 由 wide 加本词构成，义为「普遍的；广泛流传的」
由 out- 加本词构成，义为「向外张开的」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「涂抹工具；传播者」

definition_zh: 春天；泉；弹簧；跳；跃起；突然出现
definition_en: the season after winter, a natural source of water, a coiled metal device, or to jump suddenly upward or forward
core_image: 被压紧的线圈猛地弹开——水从地里涌出，冬天一过万物跃起
scene: 漫长的冬天刚刚结束，孩子们冲进院子。The children spring over the first flowers as soon as the snow melts.
sceneCN: 这里 spring 是「跳、跃起」（第 4 个义项：突然向上或向前跳）；句意为雪一融化，孩子们就跳过初开的花朵。

pos.zh: 动词：跳；跃起；突然出现；弹开

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 time 构成，义为「春季；春天时节」
由本词加后缀构成，义为「有弹性的；轻快弹跳的」
由 off- 加本词构成，义为「后代；子女」
与本词同源于「轻快跳起」的意象，义为「活泼的；轻快的」

senses.title: The season after winter
senses.definition: the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow
senses.definitionCN: 冬夏之间植物开始生长的季节
senses.example: Flowers open everywhere in early spring.
senses.exampleCN: 早春时节到处开花。
senses.why: Life leaps out of the ground after winter, like a released spring.
senses.whyCN: 冬天过后生命从地里跃出，正如被释放的弹簧。

senses.title: A natural source of water
senses.definition: a place where water flows up naturally from the ground
senses.definitionCN: 水自然从地下涌出的地方
senses.example: They drank from a clear spring on the hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 他们喝山坡上一眼清泉的水。
senses.why: Water is pushed up by the earth, the same pushing image as a jump.
senses.whyCN: 水被大地顶出，与「跳起」同属一股向上的力量。

senses.title: A coiled metal device
senses.definition: a coiled piece of metal that returns to its shape after being pressed or pulled
senses.definitionCN: 被压或拉后能恢复原状的螺旋金属件
senses.example: The old mattress still has strong springs inside.
senses.exampleCN: 旧床垫里面的弹簧还很结实。
senses.why: The coil stores force and leaps back when released.
senses.whyCN: 线圈蓄力，一松手便弹回，正是「跃起」的机械形态。

senses.title: To jump suddenly upward or forward
senses.definition: to move suddenly upward or forward with one quick movement
senses.definitionCN: 以一个快速动作突然向上或向前跳
senses.example: The cat sprang onto the table.
senses.exampleCN: 猫一跃跳上桌子。
senses.why: A jump is stored force released in one instant, like the coil.
senses.whyCN: 跳跃是瞬间释放的蓄力，正如弹簧。

senses.title: To appear suddenly
senses.definition: to appear or come into existence quickly and unexpectedly
senses.definitionCN: 快速而意外地出现或产生
senses.example: New shops sprang up along the old street.
senses.exampleCN: 老街沿线涌现出许多新店。
senses.why: Things that leap up seem to appear from nowhere, like shoots in spring.
senses.whyCN: 跃出的东西仿佛凭空出现，正如春天的嫩芽。

senses.title: Elasticity or living energy
senses.definition: the quality of being flexible and able to bounce back, or lively energy in a person
senses.definitionCN: 柔韧并能回弹的性质，或人身上的活力
senses.example: There was a new spring in his step after the good news.
senses.exampleCN: 好消息之后，他脚步轻快，充满活力。
senses.why: A person full of energy walks as if pushed upward from below.
senses.whyCN: 充满活力的人走路仿佛被下面顶起来。

senses.title: The origin or source of something
senses.definition: the place or cause from which something comes, like water from a spring
senses.definitionCN: 某物所来之处或原因，如泉水之源头
senses.example: The river has its spring in the high mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 这条河发源于高山。
senses.why: Whatever flows forward can be traced back to the spot where it first pushed up.
senses.whyCN: 任何向前流淌之物都可回溯到最初涌出的地点。

senses.title: To release from a fastening or trap
senses.definition: to make a trap, lock, or fastening operate suddenly, often to free someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 使陷阱、锁或扣件突然触发，常指解救或放出
senses.example: They sprang the trap open and freed the fox.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把陷阱弹开，放走了狐狸。
senses.why: Releasing a catch lets stored force jump out in one motion.
senses.whyCN: 松开扣件让蓄积的力量一瞬弹出。

intro.en: Spring comes from Germanic words for jumping, and the season, the water source, and the metal coil all grow from that one image of leaping up.
intro.cn: spring 源于日耳曼语「跳跃」一词，季节、泉源与金属弹簧都从「跃起」这一意象生长出来。

items.en: A root meaning "to move quickly, jump" is generally reconstructed; deeper detail is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为词根表示「快速移动、跳」；更早细节来源不确定。

items.en: Germanic languages formed a strong verb meaning "to jump, burst forth".
items.cn: 日耳曼诸语形成强变化动词，表示「跳、迸出」。

items.en: Old English springan meant "to leap up, burst out", used for both people jumping and water gushing.
items.cn: 古英语 springan 意为「跃起、迸出」，既指人跳，也指水涌。

items.en: The season name arose from the phrase "spring of the leaf", when plants leap into growth.
items.cn: 季节名来自「spring of the leaf（草木萌发之际）」一词组。

items.en: The mechanical spring, named for its leaping release, became common with industrial machinery.
items.cn: 因「弹起」而得名的机械弹簧随工业机械普及。

note.en: Spring shares its family with several jump-words and is often confused with the unrelated string group.
note.cn: spring 与多个跳跃词同族，也常与不相关的 string 词组混淆。

entries.definition: thin cord for tying things
entries.definitionCN: 细绳；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: a small stem with leaves or flowers
entries.definitionCN: 小枝；带叶小花的小茎，拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: to run at full speed for a short distance
entries.definitionCN: 短跑；冲刺；拼写相近，义为快速奔跑

entries.definition: to jump high or a long way
to push yourself off the ground and into the air
to move forward in quick large jumps
to spring back after hitting a surface
entries.definitionCN: 弹回；反弹，强调碰触后回弹

normalIntro.en: Five real links inside the word spring to fix it in memory.
normalIntro.cn: 五条 spring 词内真实关联帮助记忆。

normal.en: spr- words burst out: spring, sprout, spray, sprint all begin with sudden movement.
normal.cn: spr- 词族都带「迸发」感：spring、sprout、spray、sprint。

normal.en: The three verb forms are spring, sprang, sprung — an old strong pattern.
normal.cn: 动词三形 spring–sprang–sprung，古老强变化模式。

normal.en: off + spring = offspring: children are what springs off from parents.
normal.cn: off + spring = offspring「后代」：孩子像从父母身上跃出。

normal.en: In spring plants spring up; the season and the verb share one root.
normal.cn: 春天草木 spring up：季节与动词同根。

normal.en: A spring of water and a metal spring both push outward from inside.
normal.cn: 泉（spring）与弹簧（spring）都由内向外顶出。

abstract.en: Picture a pressed coil shooting upward the moment a hand lifts.
abstract.cn: 想象压紧的线圈在手松开的一瞬向上弹出。

abstract.en: See green shoots leaping from dark soil after the thaw.
abstract.cn: 看见解冻后绿芽从黑土中跃出。

abstract.en: Feel your own step lightening, as if the ground pushed you up.
abstract.cn: 感受脚步变轻，仿佛地面把你往上推。

examples.en: Warm days return and everything springs back to life.
examples.cn: 暖日回归，万物恢复生机。

examples.en: A spring in the old chair had broken, so the seat sagged.
examples.cn: 旧椅子的一根弹簧断了，椅面塌陷。

examples.en: The travelers filled their bottles at a mountain spring.
examples.cn: 旅行者在山泉边灌满水瓶。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯普林」——像「死扑」而跃：憋足劲死命一扑，人便像弹簧一样跳起。

root: 古英语 springan「跃起、迸出」，属日耳曼强变化动词；一般认为源于原始印欧语表示「快速移动、跳」的词根，确切形式来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: One leaping image gives spring its season, its water source, its metal coil, and its sudden appearances.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个「跃起」意象给了 spring 春天、泉源、弹簧与种种突然出现之义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stored force pushing upward in one instant
core.cn: 核心意象：蓄积的力量在一瞬向上顶出

branches.en: the season and things appearing suddenly
branches.cn: 春天与事物的突然涌现

branches.en: water pushing up and the source it marks
branches.cn: 水涌出之地与其标志的源头

branches.en: the coil, its bounce, and lively energy
the plain act of jumping
a catch released in one motion

intro.en: Spring is a simple Germanic verb, and its family is formed by compounds and related spr- words.
intro.cn: spring 是简单的日耳曼动词，其词族由复合词及相关 spr- 词构成。

latinIntro.en: Spring is Germanic, not Latin; it has no Latin relatives, so the list here is empty.
latinIntro.cn: spring 属日耳曼语源而非拉丁语源；无拉丁同族词，此列表为空。

items.meaning: children or young of a person, animal, or plant
items.example: The offspring of these birds leave the nest in early summer.
items.exampleCN: 这些鸟的幼鸟初夏离巢。

items.example: Seeds sprout within a week in warm soil.
items.exampleCN: 温土中种子一周内发芽。

items.example: The moss was springy under our feet.
items.exampleCN: 苔藓踩上去很有弹性。

items.meaning: the season of spring as a period
items.example: Springtime brings long rains to the valley.
items.exampleCN: 春季给山谷带来绵长的降雨。

items.meaning: water rising up, as in a wellspring
items.example: Her courage seemed a wellspring that never dried.
items.exampleCN: 她的勇气像永不枯竭的源泉。

items.example: Tourists bathe in the hot springs every winter.
items.exampleCN: 游客每年冬天泡温泉。

items.meaning: a flexible diving board that lifts the jumper
items.example: She stood at the end of the springboard.
items.exampleCN: 她站在跳板尽头。

items.example: The sprightly old man walked faster than us.
items.exampleCN: 那位精神矍铄的老人走得比我们还快。

derivatives.zh: 由 off- 加本词构成，义为「后代；子女」
由本词加 -y 构成，义为「有弹性的」
由本词加 time 构成，义为「春季」

definition_zh: 小队；班级；警察分队；小组
definition_en: a small group of people trained or organized to act together, such as soldiers, police officers, or team members
core_image: 一小队人肩并肩站成一列，随时一起行动
scene: 球场的更衣室里，队员们互相搭着肩。The whole squad gathered before the match to hear the coach speak.
sceneCN: 这里 squad 是「运动队全队」（第 4 个义项：一起活动的整队成员）；句意为全队在赛前聚在一起听教练讲话。

pos.zh: 名词：小队；班；分队；全队成员

derivatives.zh: 与本词同源于意大利语 scuderia 相关词族，义为「中队（空军或骑兵）」
由本词加 room 构成，义为「警察分局的办公大厅」

senses.title: A small military unit
senses.definition: the smallest military unit, usually several soldiers acting under one leader
senses.definitionCN: 最小的军事单位，通常为若干士兵由一名班长带领
senses.example: A squad of ten soldiers guarded the bridge at night.
senses.exampleCN: 一支十人的小队夜间守卫那座桥。
senses.why: Soldiers stand and move as one block; the smallness is the point.
senses.whyCN: 士兵作为一个整体站立与行动，「小」正是要点。

senses.title: A police or emergency team
senses.definition: a small group of officers trained for one special kind of task
senses.definitionCN: 为某种专门任务训练的警务小组
senses.example: The drug squad raided the warehouse at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 缉毒小组在黎明突袭了那座仓库。
senses.why: Special dangers need a team that trains and moves together.
senses.whyCN: 特殊的危险需要一起训练、一起行动的小组。

senses.title: A school class or work group
senses.definition: a group of students or workers who do things together, often informally
senses.definitionCN: 一起行动的学生或工作者群体，常为非正式说法
senses.example: The whole squad stayed late to clean the classroom.
senses.exampleCN: 全班留下来很晚打扫教室。
senses.why: Informal speech borrows the military word for any close-working group.
senses.whyCN: 口语把军事词借来称呼任何紧密合作的群体。

senses.title: The members of a sports team
senses.definition: all the players available for a sports team, including reserves
senses.definitionCN: 一支运动队的全部可用队员，包括替补
senses.example: Two new players joined the squad this season.
senses.exampleCN: 本赛季有两名新队员加入阵容。
senses.why: The team as a pool of players is one block ready to move.
senses.whyCN: 作为球员集合的队伍是一整块随时可调动的力量。

senses.title: A squad assigned to punishment or duty
senses.titleCN: 执行惩罚或特殊任务的队伍
senses.definition: a group formed to carry out a specific harsh duty, such as a firing squad
senses.definitionCN: 为执行某项严酷任务而组的小队，如行刑队
senses.example: The firing squad stood in a straight line.
senses.exampleCN: 行刑队站成笔直的一排。
senses.why: The same small block of people is pointed at one grim task.
senses.whyCN: 同一小块人群被指向某项严酷任务。

senses.title: A group of friends or helpers
senses.definition: an informal group of friends who do things together
senses.definitionCN: 一起行动的朋友圈，非正式用法
senses.example: She brought her usual squad to the party.
senses.exampleCN: 她带着老搭档们来参加聚会。
senses.why: Modern slang keeps only the togetherness, dropping the military tone.
senses.whyCN: 现代俚语只保留「同行者」之意，去掉军事色彩。

senses.title: To organize people into squads
senses.definition: to arrange people into small working groups
senses.definitionCN: 把人编排成小组
senses.example: The teacher squadded the students for the project.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把学生分成小组做项目。
senses.why: The noun turns into a verb: making blocks out of many people.
senses.whyCN: 名词转作动词：把许多人切成一个个小块。

intro.en: Squad traveled from Latin through French military use, always meaning a small square of people formed for action.
intro.cn: squad 经由法语军事用法从拉丁语一路传来，始终指为行动而排成的方形小队。

items.en: A form related to exquadra is generally thought to mean "one's own square of troops", from quadra "square"; details are source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为其通俗拉丁语形式与 exquadra 相关，意为「自己的方形队列」，源自 quadra「方形」；细节来源不确定。

items.en: French escouade and Italian squadra meant a small formed group of soldiers.
items.cn: 法语 escouade 与意大利语 squadra 指编成的小队士兵。

items.en: The French army used escouade for the smallest drill unit.
items.cn: 十七世纪法军用 escouade 指最小的操练单位。

items.en: English took squad from French for the same small military block.
items.cn: 英语从法语借入 squad，指同样的小型军队建制。

items.en: The word widened to police units, sports rosters, and slang for a friend group.
items.cn: 词义扩展到警察分队、运动队名单以及指朋友圈的俚语。

note.en: Squad belongs to a family of group-words and shares its shape with the square family.
note.cn: squad 属于群体词族，且与 square 词族共享形状意象。

entries.definition: a shape with four equal sides, from the same Latin quadra
entries.definitionCN: 正方形；与 squad 同源于拉丁 quadra「方形」

entries.definition: a larger military unit of cavalry or aircraft
entries.definitionCN: 中队；同根的更大军事建制

entries.definition: to bend low with legs folded, or short and thick
entries.definitionCN: 蹲；矮胖的；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: a group working or playing together
an organized group within a larger force
the people who work on a ship, aircraft, or project
a military unit larger than a squad

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks inside squad and its family.
normalIntro.cn: 五条 squad 词内真实记忆钩子。

normal.en: squad and square share the Latin root quadra: a squad is a square of people.
normal.cn: squad 与 square 同源于 quadra：一个班就是一「方」人。

normal.en: squadron is squad with -ron: a bigger flying or riding block.
normal.cn: squadron 加大后缀 -ron：更大的飞行或骑兵建制。

normal.en: Bomb squad, drug squad, firing squad: the word attaches to one special task.
normal.cn: 排爆小组、缉毒小组、行刑队：squad 总跟着一项专门任务。

normal.en: Sports news keeps squad for the full player list.
normal.cn: 体育新闻用 squad 指全队名单。

normal.en: Slang squad of friends: only the shoulder-to-shoulder part survives.
normal.cn: 俚语里 squad 指朋友团：只剩肩并肩的意思。

abstract.en: Picture four people standing shoulder to shoulder in a small square.
abstract.cn: 想象四人肩并肩站成一个小方阵。

abstract.en: Hear one whistle: the whole block moves at once, no one alone.
abstract.cn: 听一声哨响：整块队伍同时行动，无人落单。

abstract.en: See a coach pointing at a whiteboard list of names: the squad.
abstract.cn: 看教练指着白板上的名单：这就是全队。

examples.en: A rescue squad reached the mountain village before nightfall.
examples.cn: 救援小队在夜幕降临前抵达山村。

examples.en: The coach named the final squad for the tournament.
examples.cn: 教练公布了参赛的最终名单。

examples.en: Our project squad met every Friday afternoon.
examples.cn: 我们的项目小组每周五下午碰头。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯夸德」——像「四夸」而蹲：四个人夸成一堆蹲成小方阵，一喊就走。

root: 一般认为 squad 经法语 escouade / 意大利语 squadra 上溯至通俗拉丁语 exquadra「方形队列」，源自 quadra「方形」；此路径为通常看法，细节来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: From the square block of soldiers, squad extends to police units, teams of players, work groups, and friends.
sensesIntro.cn: squad 从士兵的方形队列出发，扩展到警察分队、球员名单、工作小组与朋友圈。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small square of people formed to act together
core.cn: 核心意象：为共同行动而排成的小方阵

branches.en: military blocks and the grim tasks they draw
branches.cn: 军事建制与其领受的严酷任务

branches.en: police units trained for one danger
branches.cn: 针对一种危险训练的警察小组

branches.en: civil groups borrowed for class, work, and friends
branches.cn: 借入班级、工作与朋友语境的民间群体

branches.en: the full roster of a sports team
branches.cn: 运动队的全部队员名单

branches.en: the act of dividing people into such blocks
branches.cn: 把人分成这种小块的动作

intro.en: Squad builds its family through the Latin square root quadra and size suffixes.
intro.cn: squad 的词族围绕拉丁「方形」词根 quadra 与大小后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root quadra, "a square", gives squad, square, and squadron their shared shape.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 quadra「方形」赋予 squad、square、squadron 共同的形状意象。

items.example: Latin quadra gives both square and squad their form image.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 quadra 给 square 与 squad 带来方形意象。

items.meaning: out of one's own; one's own square
items.example: Exquadra meant one's own formed square of troops.
items.exampleCN: exquadra 指自己编成的方阵。

items.example: A squadron of jets flew overhead.
items.exampleCN: 一个中队的战机从头顶飞过。

items.example: A quadrangle has four sides around a court.
items.exampleCN: 四合院式的庭院有四面环绕。

items.example: A small parade squad walked behind the band.
items.exampleCN: 一支小方队走在乐队后面。

items.example: The bomb squad closed the street for hours.
items.exampleCN: 排爆小组封锁那条街数小时。

items.meaning: the group assigned to an execution detail
items.example: The term firing squad dates from military law.
items.exampleCN: firing squad 一词源自军法。

items.example: The cheer squad practiced on the field.
items.exampleCN: 啦啦队在操场上练习。

由本词加 room 构成，义为「警局办公大厅」

definition_en: a shape with four equal sides and right angles, an open public area in a town, the result of multiplying a number by itself, or fair and even
core_image: 一块四边等长的方地——城市中央留出的空场，账目两端对齐
scene: 市中心的喷泉边，鸽子成群起落。Tourists feed the birds in the old town square every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 square 是「广场」（第 2 个义项：城中开阔的公共空地）；句意为游客每天早晨在老城广场喂鸽子。

pos.zh: 名词：正方形；广场；平方；方格
形容词：方形的；直角的；公正的
动词：使成方形；求平方；结清（账目）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ed 构成，义为「画成方格的；带平方记号的」

senses.title: A shape with four equal sides
senses.definition: a flat shape with four equal sides and four right angles
senses.definitionCN: 四边等长、四角皆直角的平面图形
senses.example: Draw a square on the board and cut it out.
senses.exampleCN: 在板上画一个正方形并剪下来。
senses.why: The word came from Latin quadra, a four-sided block.
senses.whyCN: 词来自拉丁语 quadra「四边形石块」。

senses.title: An open public area in a town
senses.definition: an open area in a town where streets meet, often with gardens or a market
senses.definitionCN: 城中街道交汇处的开阔场地，常有花园或市场
senses.example: Crowds gathered in the main square after the match.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛结束后人群聚集在主广场。
senses.why: Towns were laid out in blocks; the open block became the square.
senses.whyCN: 城市按方格规划，开阔的一块地便成了 square。

senses.title: A number multiplied by itself
senses.definition: the result of multiplying a number by itself
senses.definitionCN: 一个数与自身相乘的结果
senses.example: The square of five is twenty-five.
senses.exampleCN: 五的平方是二十五。
senses.why: A number times itself draws a perfect square of points.
senses.whyCN: 数自乘正好排出一个整齐的点阵正方形。

senses.title: Having four equal sides or right angles
senses.definition: shaped like a square, or having sides meeting at right angles
senses.definitionCN: 形状方正，或两边相交成直角
senses.example: He wore a square frame bag over his shoulder.
senses.exampleCN: 他肩上挎着一只方框包。
senses.why: The shape itself becomes the describing word.
senses.whyCN: 形状直接用作形容词。

senses.title: Fair and honest
senses.definition: fair, honest, and with nothing owed by either side
senses.definitionCN: 公平、诚实，双方两不相欠
senses.example: Everyone agreed it was a square deal.
senses.exampleCN: 大家都认为那是一场公平交易。
senses.why: When the sides of a deal match evenly, it is like equal sides of a shape.
senses.whyCN: 交易两边对齐，正如四边相等的图形。

senses.title: To make even or settle a debt
senses.definition: to pay what is owed, or to make accounts and ideas agree with each other
senses.definitionCN: 还清欠款，或使账目、说法彼此吻合
senses.example: He squared his account before leaving the hotel.
senses.exampleCN: 离开旅馆前他结清了账目。
senses.why: Settling a debt puts both sides level, like equal sides.
senses.whyCN: 结清债务让两边齐平，如等边。

senses.title: To raise a number to its square
senses.definition: to multiply a number by itself as a mathematical operation
senses.definitionCN: 数学运算中把一个数自乘
senses.example: Square both sides of the equation to remove the root.
senses.exampleCN: 把方程两边平方以去掉根号。
senses.why: The action makes a number into its square shape of value.
senses.whyCN: 该动作把数值变成它的「平方」形态。

senses.title: A square of board or cloth in games and tools
senses.definition: one marked cell on a board game or grid, or a tool for drawing right angles
senses.definitionCN: 棋盘或网格上的一个方格，或画直角的工具
senses.example: Move your piece three squares forward.
senses.exampleCN: 把你的棋子向前移三格。
senses.why: Any small block on a grid keeps the shape name.
senses.whyCN: 网格上的任何小块都沿用形状名。

intro.en: Square came from Latin through Old French, and its story is the story of the four-sided block: shape, open ground, math, and fairness.
intro.cn: square 经古法语来自拉丁语，其历史就是四边形石块的历史：形状、空地、数学与公正。

items.en: A root meaning "four" underlies the family, through Latin quattuor; the link is generally accepted.
items.cn: 该词族一般认为经由拉丁语 quattuor「四」追溯到表示「四」的原始印欧词根。

items.en: Latin quadrus meant "square", and exquadrare meant "to make square".
items.cn: 拉丁语 quadrus 意为「方的」，exquadrare 意为「使成方形」。

items.en: Old French esquarre / esquare carried the shape word into French use.
items.cn: 古法语 esquarre / esquare 承载了这一形状词。

items.en: English took square in the 13th century, first for the shape and the carpenter's tool.
items.cn: 英语于十三世纪借入 square，最初指形状与木工角尺。

items.en: Meanings grew to the town square, arithmetic squares, fair dealing, and a square meal.
items.cn: 词义增长为城镇广场、数学平方、公平交易乃至丰盛一餐。

note.en: Square heads a large Latin quad-family and is often paired with circle as its opposite.
note.cn: square 领衔庞大的拉丁 quad 词族，并常与 circle 构成对照。

entries.definition: a small formed group of people, from the same quadra root
entries.definitionCN: 小队；与 square 同源于 quadra「方形」

entries.definition: directly and firmly in position
entries.definitionCN: 径直地；正对地，由 square 派生的副词

entries.definition: square-shaped, from the same Latin quadratus
entries.definitionCN: 方形的；与 square 同源于拉丁 quadratus

entries.definition: a four-sided shape with right angles but unequal sides
entries.definitionCN: 长方形；直角但边不等长

normalIntro.en: Five real connections that hold square in memory.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实关联帮助记住 square。

normal.en: squad and square share quadra: a squad is a little square of people.
normal.cn: squad 与 square 同根：小队就是一小「方」人。

normal.en: square root undoes square: 5 squared is 25, its root is 5.
normal.cn: 平方根逆平方：5 的平方是 25，25 的平方根是 5。

normal.en: a square meal: a fair, complete meal, square as fair.
normal.cn: a square meal「丰盛一餐」：square 既方正又公平。

normal.en: Be there or be square: slang for "boring like a box".
normal.cn: 俚语 be there or be square：不来的人像盒子一样古板。

normal.en: Town squares were laid out as blocks: shape became place.
normal.cn: 城镇广场按方格规划：形状变成了地点。

abstract.en: Picture four equal walls meeting at perfect corners.
abstract.cn: 想象四面等长墙体在完美直角处相接。

abstract.en: See an open plaza where four streets cross.
abstract.cn: 看见四条街道交汇处的一块开阔广场。

abstract.en: Feel a balanced scale: both sides even, nothing owed.
abstract.cn: 感受平衡的天平：两边齐平，两不相欠。

examples.en: The children sat on the steps of the square to watch the fountain.
examples.cn: 孩子们坐在广场台阶上看喷泉。

examples.en: Three squared gives nine, an easy fact to remember.
examples.cn: 三的平方得九，很好记。

examples.en: They squared the account at the end of the month.
examples.cn: 他们在月底结清了账目。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯奎尔」——像「撕缺口」不如补成方：撕破的角补齐四边，又方又平。

sensesIntro.en: One four-sided block gives square its shape, its public ground, its math, and its fairness.
sensesIntro.cn: 一块四边形石块给了 square 形状、空地、数学与公正诸义。

core.cn: 核心意象：四边等长、四角皆直角

branches.cn: 图形在画、物与网格中的呈现

intro.en: Square anchors a wide Latin family built on the idea of four.
intro.cn: square 是以「四」为核心的大型拉丁词族的一员。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root quadrus, "square", from quattuor "four", gives the family its shape.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 quadrus「方的」源自 quattuor「四」，为整个词族定形。

items.example: Latin quattuor is the base of the whole quad-family.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 quattuor 是整个 quad 词族的基础。

items.example: Quadrus stones built the Roman wall.
items.exampleCN: 方形的石块砌成了罗马墙。

items.example: Students met in the college quadrangle.
items.exampleCN: 学生们在学院庭院里碰头。

items.meaning: to make four times as much
items.example: Prices quadrupled within a decade.
items.exampleCN: 十年间价格翻了两番。

items.meaning: a quarter of a circle or instrument
items.example: The point lies in the first quadrant.
items.exampleCN: 该点位于第一象限。

items.example: The ball hit him squarely on the shoulder.
items.exampleCN: 球正中他的肩膀。

items.meaning: used in compounds like square meal, square root

items.example: We learned square roots in class today.
items.exampleCN: 今天课上我们学了平方根。

items.example: Exquadrare meant to form a proper square.
items.exampleCN: exquadrare 意为排成规整的方阵。

definition_zh: 挤；捏；榨；挤出；挤压；压榨；紧紧拥抱；挤过
definition_en: to press something firmly from opposite sides, or to get something out or through by pressing
core_image: 两只手掌从两侧用力向内合拢——汁水被榨出，身体从缝隙钻过
scene: 清晨的厨房里，橙子被切成了两半。She gave the orange half a hard squeeze and juice ran into the glass.
sceneCN: 这里 squeeze 是「挤、榨」（第 1 个义项：用力挤压取汁）；句意为她用力一挤半个橙子，果汁流进了杯子。

pos.zh: 名词：挤压；榨取；紧握；拮据

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -er 构成，义为「榨汁器；挤压工具」
由本词加-ing 构成，义为「挤压（动作）」
由本词构成的俚语短语，义为「头号人物；要紧之人」

senses.title: To press something firmly from two sides
senses.definition: to press something hard from opposite sides, often to get liquid out
senses.definitionCN: 从相对两侧用力压某物，常为挤出汁液
senses.example: She squeezed the lemon over the fish.
senses.exampleCN: 她把柠檬挤在鱼上。
senses.why: Two forces meet on one object; what is inside is pushed out.
senses.whyCN: 两股力在同一物体上相遇，内部的东西被推出来。

senses.title: To get through a narrow space
senses.definition: to manage to pass through a narrow or crowded space
senses.definitionCN: 设法通过狭窄或拥挤的空间
senses.example: He squeezed through the gap in the fence.
senses.exampleCN: 他从篱笆的缺口挤了过去。
senses.why: Narrow walls press the body from both sides, like hands on fruit.
senses.whyCN: 狭窄的两壁从两侧挤压身体，如手掌挤压果子。

senses.title: To force something out of a place or position
senses.definition: to force something or someone out of a position or market by pressure
senses.definitionCN: 用压力把某物或某人挤出某位置或市场
senses.example: Big stores squeezed out the small shops nearby.
senses.exampleCN: 大商店把附近的小店排挤了出去。
senses.why: Pressure from one side pushes the other side out of its place.
senses.whyCN: 一侧施压把另一侧挤出原有的位置。

senses.title: To press someone gently to show affection
senses.definition: to press a hand or arm lightly as a sign of warmth or support
senses.definitionCN: 轻握或轻捏他人的手、臂以表达温情或支持
senses.example: She gave his hand a gentle squeeze.
senses.exampleCN: 她轻轻捏了捏他的手。
senses.why: The same two-sided pressure, softened into a message of care.
senses.whyCN: 同样的双侧压力，被柔化成关怀的讯息。

senses.title: To manage to fit into time or space
senses.definition: to find room for something in a full schedule or space
senses.definitionCN: 在排满的时间表或空间里为某物腾出位置
senses.example: Can you squeeze in one more meeting today?
senses.exampleCN: 今天还能再安排一个会吗？
senses.why: A full schedule presses back; only force makes room.
senses.whyCN: 排满的日程如两壁相夹，须用力才腾出空隙。

senses.title: To press hard for money or advantage
senses.definition: to put pressure on someone to get money or unfair advantage
senses.definitionCN: 对某人施压以获取钱财或不正当好处
senses.example: The landlord squeezed every last coin from his tenants.
senses.exampleCN: 房东从租客身上榨取最后一枚硬币。
senses.why: People under pressure yield value, like fruit under the hand.
senses.whyCN: 受压的人会交出价值，如被手握住的果子。

senses.title: A difficult situation caused by lack
senses.definition: a period when money or supplies are hard to get
senses.definitionCN: 钱财或物资紧缺的时期
senses.example: Rising costs put a real squeeze on family budgets.
senses.exampleCN: 物价上涨让家庭预算颇为吃紧。
senses.why: Outside forces press in on the budget from both sides.
senses.whyCN: 外部力量从两侧挤压预算。

senses.title: The act or grip of squeezing
senses.definition: a single act of pressing, or the grip made by squeezing
senses.definitionCN: 一次按压的动作，或挤压形成的握力
senses.example: One firm squeeze of the trigger fired the shot.
senses.exampleCN: 用力一扣扳机，枪就响了。
senses.why: The action itself becomes a countable noun.
senses.whyCN: 动作本身成为可数名词。

intro.en: Squeeze is an odd word: it appeared in English suddenly and its deeper origin is uncertain, though its meaning of pressing has never changed.
intro.cn: squeeze 来历特殊：它在英语中突然出现，更早的词源不确定，但「挤压」的含义从未改变。

items.en: No certain older root has been traced; some suggest a dialect or imitative source, all marked source uncertain.
items.cn: 尚未找到确切的上古词根；有方言起源或拟声起源之说，均属来源不确定。

items.en: The verb squeeze appears in English texts of the early 17th century, meaning to press hard.
items.cn: 动词 squeeze 于十七世纪初见诸英语文本，意为用力按压。

items.en: Old English cwysan "to crush" and related dialect words are cited as possible cousins, but the connection is not proven.
items.cn: 有人举出古英语 cwysan「压碎」及方言词为可能的亲属，但关联未获证实。

items.en: The noun sense of pressure and extortion developed in trade and social writing.
items.cn: 名词的「压力」「勒索」义在商业与社会文字中发展。

items.en: Modern use extends to budget squeezes, market squeezes, and affectionate squeezes.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖预算紧缩、市场挤压与亲昵的轻捏。

note.en: Squeeze shares one meaning-field with press-words and one shape-field with squ- words.
note.cn: squeeze 与按压类词共享一个义场，又与 squ- 词共享音形。

entries.definitionCN: 打喷嚏；拼写相近但词源不同

normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 squeeze。

normal.en: squeezy family: breeze, freeze, squeeze all end in -eeze.
normal.cn: breeze、freeze、squeeze 都以 -eeze 结尾，成族记。

normal.en: Orange test: you squeeze an orange to get juice.

normal.en: A tight squeeze means either a narrow gap or money trouble.
normal.cn: a tight squeeze 既指窄缝也指手头紧，一词两用。

normal.en: squeezer is a real tool name for lemon juicers.
normal.cn: squeezer 是柠檬榨汁器的真实名称。

normal.en: Two hands, two sides, one object: the geometry of squeeze.
normal.cn: 两手、两侧、一物：squeeze 的几何画面。

abstract.en: Feel two palms closing on a sponge until water runs out.
abstract.cn: 感受双掌合拢挤压海绵，直到水流出来。

abstract.en: See yourself turning sideways to pass a narrow gate.
abstract.cn: 看见自己侧身钻过一道窄门。

abstract.en: Picture a calendar so full that only force makes room.
abstract.cn: 想象排满的日程表，只有用力才挤出空位。

examples.en: He squeezed the sponge until every drop of water was gone.
examples.cn: 他把海绵拧到一滴水都不剩。

examples.en: Hundreds of fans squeezed through the narrow gate.
examples.cn: 数百名球迷挤过狭窄的大门。

examples.en: The city faces a budget squeeze this winter.
examples.cn: 今冬该市面临预算吃紧。

sensesIntro.en: Squeeze keeps one image throughout: two forces closing in, whether for juice, for space, for affection, or for money.
sensesIntro.cn: squeeze 贯穿一个意象：两股力向内合拢——为取汁、为过隙、为亲昵、为钱财。

latinIntro.cn: squeeze 无确切的拉丁祖先，拉丁同族列表为空。

items.example: In slang, a main squeeze is the key person.

definition_en: firmly fixed and not likely to move or change, or a building where horses are kept
core_image: 四条腿踏实的马厩与站稳不晃的马——一切都立得牢
scene: 雨后的农场里，木门吱呀作响。The farmer led the tired horse back into its warm stable for the night.
sceneCN: 这里 stable 是「马厩」（第 5 个义项：养马的建筑物）；句意为农夫把疲惫的马牵回温暖的马厩过夜。

pos.zh: 形容词：稳定的；稳固的；沉稳的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「稳定性；稳固」

senses.title: Firmly fixed, not moving
senses.definition: physically firm and not likely to fall or move
senses.definitionCN: 物理上牢固，不易倒下或移动
senses.example: Make sure the ladder is stable before you climb.
senses.exampleCN: 爬梯子前先确认它放稳了。
senses.why: A thing that stands on a wide base holds still.
senses.whyCN: 立足面宽的东西站得稳。

senses.title: Not changing or likely to change
senses.definition: staying at the same level or state over time
senses.definitionCN: 长时间保持同一水平或状态
senses.example: The country enjoyed stable prices for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家多年来物价平稳。
senses.why: What holds still physically also holds still in numbers and moods.
senses.whyCN: 物理上不动的，在数字与情绪上也不动摇。

senses.title: Calm and sensible in character
senses.definition: having a calm, reasonable personality that does not swing suddenly
senses.definitionCN: 性格沉着理性，不会突然波动
senses.example: She is the most stable member of the team.
senses.exampleCN: 她是队里最沉稳的人。
senses.why: A steady person is a steady building among people.
senses.whyCN: 沉稳的人如同人群中一栋不晃的建筑。

senses.title: Chemically or medically not changing
senses.definition: not likely to break down, react, or worsen, as a compound or a patient
senses.definitionCN: 化合物不易分解反应，或病人病情不再恶化
senses.example: The patient is now in a stable condition.
senses.exampleCN: 病人目前情况稳定。
senses.why: Science borrows the standing-still image for matter and bodies.
senses.whyCN: 科学把「站立不动」的意象借给物质与身体。

senses.title: A building for horses
senses.definition: a building where horses are kept and fed
senses.definitionCN: 养马、喂马的建筑物
senses.example: There are twelve stalls in the new stable.
senses.exampleCN: 新马厩里有十二个栏位。
senses.why: The same Latin root meant a standing place for animals.
senses.whyCN: 同一拉丁词根本指牲口站立安顿之处。

senses.title: The horses owned or trained together
senses.titleCN: 统指一家的马匹；赛马群体
senses.definition: all the racehorses belonging to one owner or trainer
senses.definitionCN: 属于同一主人或训练师的全部赛马
senses.example: The champion horse is the pride of his stable.
senses.exampleCN: 这匹冠军马是马房引以为傲的宝贝。
senses.why: The building stands for everything kept inside it.
senses.whyCN: 建筑物代指其中饲养的一切。

senses.title: To put a horse into a stable
senses.definition: to keep a horse in a stable, especially for the night
senses.definitionCN: 把马安置在马厩中，尤指过夜
senses.example: The riders stabled their horses and went to dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 骑手们把马拴进马厩后去吃饭。
senses.why: Putting the horse where it stands still gives the verb.
senses.whyCN: 让马站定安顿，便有了这个动词。

intro.en: Stable the adjective and stable the barn are two different words: one from Latin stabilis "able to stand", one from Latin stabulum "a standing place".
intro.cn: 形容词 stable 与马厩 stable 是两个词：一个来自拉丁语 stabilis「能站立的」，一个来自 stabulum「牲口站立之所」。

items.en: A root meaning "to stand" underlies both words; the reconstruction is generally accepted.
items.cn: 表示「站立」的词根是两词共同基础；这一重构被普遍接受。

items.en: Latin stabilis meant "able to stand, firm"; stabulum meant "a stall or standing place for animals".
items.cn: 拉丁语 stabilis 意为「能站立、牢固」；stabulum 意为「牲口的栏厩」。

items.en: Old French gave English both estable "firm" and estable "barn".
items.cn: 古法语将 estable「牢固」与 estable「厩栏」一并传入英语。

items.en: The two homonyms settled in Middle English with different spellings in time.
items.cn: 两个同形词进入中古英语，拼写逐渐分化。

items.en: The adjective grew scientific senses, the noun grew the racing sense and the verb.
items.cn: 形容词发展出科学义项，名词发展出赛马义与动词用法。

note.en: Stable pairs with its opposite unstable, and the horse-barn word shares spelling with the firm word.
note.cn: stable 与反义词 unstable 成对，而马厩义与牢固义同形。

abstract.en: Feel a table that never wobbles when you lean on it.
abstract.cn: 感受一张怎么靠都不晃的桌子。

abstract.en: Picture a line on a graph going flat and staying flat.

examples.en: After the storm the old bridge was still stable.

examples.en: The trainer led each horse into its own stable.
examples.cn: 驯马师把每匹马牵进各自的马厩。

examples.en: She kept her voice stable during the interview.
examples.cn: 面试时她保持声音平稳。

scene: 新酒店开业前的清晨，大厅灯一盏盏亮起。The hotel staff gathered in the lobby to hear the manager's welcome speech.
sceneCN: 这里 staff 是「全体员工」（第 1 个义项：机构的所有工作人员）；句意为酒店员工在大厅集合听取经理的欢迎致辞。

pos.zh: 名词：全体职员；杆；杖；五线谱

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ing 构成，义为「人员配备；人事安排」
与本词同源的历史变体，义为「梯级；桶板；五线谱」
由 under- 加本词构成，义为「人手不足的」

senses.title: All the workers of an organization
senses.definition: the group of people who work for a school, company, or institution
senses.definitionCN: 为学校、公司或机构工作的全体人员
senses.example: The hospital staff worked through the night.
senses.exampleCN: 医院员工彻夜工作。
senses.why: The people who keep an organization upright are its supporting rods.
senses.whyCN: 支撑机构运转的人如同撑起它的杖。

senses.title: A long stick for support
senses.definition: a long straight stick carried for support or used as a tool
senses.definitionCN: 为支撑或作工具而持的长直棍
senses.example: The old shepherd leaned on his staff.
senses.exampleCN: 老牧人拄着他的手杖。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: the stick that holds a person up.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老义项：把人撑起来的棍。

senses.title: A flag pole or military symbol
senses.definition: a pole carrying a flag, or officers who plan and direct military work
senses.definitionCN: 悬挂旗帜的杆，或负责筹划指挥的军官群体
senses.example: The general discussed the plan with his staff.
senses.exampleCN: 将军与参谋们讨论作战计划。
senses.why: The command staff gathers around the leader like a pole around a flag.
senses.whyCN: 参谋群体围绕主帅，如旗杆撑起旗帜。

senses.title: The five lines for writing music
senses.definition: the five parallel lines on which music notes are written
senses.definitionCN: 书写音符的五条平行线
senses.example: She wrote the melody on a blank staff.
senses.exampleCN: 她把旋律写在空白五线谱上。
senses.why: The five lines stand together like five thin staves.
senses.whyCN: 五条线并立，如五根细杆。

senses.title: To provide workers for a place
senses.definition: to supply an office, shop, or event with workers
senses.definitionCN: 为办公室、商店或活动提供工作人员
senses.example: The clinic is staffed by twelve nurses.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所由十二名护士任职。
senses.why: Filling a place with people is planting rods of support in it.
senses.whyCN: 用人填满一个场所，如同在其中插起支撑之杖。

senses.title: A rod of authority carried as a sign
senses.definition: a stick carried as a sign of office or rank
senses.definitionCN: 作为职位或等级标志而持的杆
senses.example: The marshal raised the staff of office.
senses.exampleCN: 执法官举起权杖。
senses.why: Whoever holds the stick holds the authority it stands for.
senses.whyCN: 执杖者即握有杖所代表的权力。

intro.en: Staff is an old Germanic word for a stick, and the people sense grew from the idea of one supporting rod under an organization.
intro.cn: staff 是古老的日耳曼「棍杖」词，「人员」义从「一根支撑机构之杖」的意象生长出来。

items.en: A root meaning "to support, stand" is generally reconstructed; exact detail is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为词根表示「支撑、站立」；确切细节来源不确定。

items.en: Germanic formed words for a walking stick or pole, related to stave.
items.cn: 日耳曼语形成了指手杖或杆的词，与 stave 同源。

items.en: Old English stæf meant a staff or rod, used for support, symbols, and verses of poetry.
items.cn: 古英语 stæf 指杖或杆，用于支撑、象征及诗歌的「节」。

items.en: The military and musical senses developed, and staves became the plural for poles.
items.cn: 军事与音乐义项发展，staves 成为「杆」的复数。

items.en: The workers sense became the everyday meaning, with a verb for supplying workers.
items.cn: 「全体员工」成为日常义，并衍生出配备人员的动词。

note.en: Staff shares its family with stave and pole-words, and sounds like the unrelated stuff.
note.cn: staff 与 stave 及杆类词同族，且与不相关的 stuff 发音相近。

entries.definition: things or material in general
entries.definitionCN: 东西；材料；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: a rung, barrel strip, or staff variant
entries.definitionCN: 梯级；桶板；staff 的同源变体

entries.definition: a member of a staff
the people employed in an organization
the workers of a ship or aircraft
a long round stick
a thin straight stick or bar

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for staff and its two lives.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 staff 的双重身份。

normal.en: staff and stave are one old word split into two spellings.
normal.cn: staff 与 stave 本是一词，拼写分化为二。

normal.en: Staff carries a flag; staff officers gather under it.
normal.cn: staff 是旗杆；staff officers 聚于旗下。

normal.en: Five thin rods make the musical staff.
normal.cn: 五根细线组成五线谱 staff。

normal.en: understaffed: not enough rods to hold the roof up.
normal.cn: understaffed「人手不足」：撑顶的杖不够。

normal.en: Staffed by nurses: the verb plants people into a place.
normal.cn: staffed by nurses：动词把人「栽」进场所。

abstract.en: See a shepherd leaning on one tall stick on a hill.
abstract.cn: 看见牧人倚一根长杖站在山坡。

abstract.en: Picture employees standing shoulder to shoulder under a flag.
abstract.cn: 想象员工们在旗帜下并肩而立。

abstract.en: Hear five lines hum like one thin fence of sound.
abstract.cn: 听五条线像一道细声的栅栏在嗡鸣。

examples.en: The shop staff helped every customer during the holiday rush.
examples.cn: 节日高峰期店员为每位顾客提供帮助。

examples.en: He carved his name into the wooden staff he carried.
examples.cn: 他在随身木杖上刻下自己的名字。

examples.en: The new branch is staffed by local teachers.
examples.cn: 新分校由本地教师任职。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯达夫」——像「四大夫」：四大夫各执一杖，撑起整个衙门。

root: 古英语 stæf「杖、杆」，属日耳曼语源，与 stave 同源；一般认为出自表示「支撑、站立」的印欧词根，确切形式来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: One supporting rod becomes a walking stick, a flag pole, five music lines, and finally the people who hold an organization up.
sensesIntro.cn: 一根支撑之杖化作手杖、旗杆、五线谱，最终化作撑起机构的全体人手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one long rod that holds something up
core.cn: 核心意象：一根撑住某物的长杖

branches.en: people as the rods that support an organization
branches.cn: 作为支撑机构之杖的人

branches.en: sticks for support and for authority
branches.cn: 用于支撑与象征权力的杖

branches.en: the flag pole and the officers beneath it
five thin rods as the music lines
the everyday workers sense

intro.en: Staff is a bare Germanic word; its family grows by compounds rather than prefixes.
intro.cn: staff 是光杆日耳曼词；其词族靠复合词而非前缀扩展。

latinIntro.en: Staff has no Latin relatives; it is Germanic through and through.
latinIntro.cn: staff 没有拉丁同族词；它是纯粹的日耳曼词。

items.meaning: a barrel strip or a rung of a ladder
items.example: One loose stave made the barrel leak.
items.exampleCN: 一块松动的桶板让桶漏水。

items.example: The ward is understaffed at night.
items.exampleCN: 病区夜间人手不足。

items.example: A new staffer joined the front desk.
items.exampleCN: 一名新职员加入了前台。

items.example: Staffing for the holiday shift starts now.
items.exampleCN: 假期班次的人员配备现在开始。

items.meaning: staff room, staff meeting, staff car
items.meaningCN: 构成 staff room 等复合词
items.example: Teachers talk in the staff room.
items.exampleCN: 教师们在休息室交谈。

items.example: The chief of staff read the report.
items.exampleCN: 参谋长看了报告。

items.example: A gold eagle topped the flag staff.
items.exampleCN: 旗杆顶端有一只金鹰。

items.meaning: the musical staff of five lines
items.example: Notes sit on the five-line staff.
items.exampleCN: 音符写在五线谱上。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ing 构成，义为「人员配备」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「职员；工作人员」

definition_zh: 阶段；舞台；步骤；上演；举办；使出现
definition_en: a period or step in a process, or the raised floor where actors perform; also to arrange or present something
core_image: 剧院的木台与登台的一级台阶——每一步都把事物推到观众眼前
scene: 幕布拉开前，后台一片安静。The dancers waited behind the curtain before stepping onto the stage.
sceneCN: 这里 stage 是「舞台」（第 2 个义项：演员表演的高台）；句意为舞者们在幕布后等待登台。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ing 构成，义为「舞台布置；（医）分期；分段运输」
由 back- 加本词构成，义为「在后台」
由本词加 coach 构成，义为「（旧时）驿站马车」

senses.title: A period or step in a process
senses.definition: one distinct period in the development of something
senses.definitionCN: 事物发展过程中一个明确的时期
senses.example: The plan is still at an early stage.
senses.exampleCN: 计划仍处于早期阶段。
senses.why: Each step of a journey is like one raised floor after another.
senses.whyCN: 旅程的每一步如同一级级抬高的台面。

senses.title: The raised floor in a theater
senses.definition: the area in a theater where actors perform
senses.definitionCN: 剧场中演员表演的高台区域
senses.example: The whole stage was flooded with warm light.
senses.exampleCN: 整个舞台沐浴在暖光中。
senses.why: Actors are lifted above the crowd to be seen.
senses.whyCN: 演员被抬高到人群之上以便被看见。

senses.title: A stop on a journey
senses.definition: one section of a journey between two stopping places
senses.definitionCN: 两处歇脚点之间的行程段落
senses.example: They finished the first stage of the climb by noon.
senses.exampleCN: 中午前他们完成了登山的第一个阶段。
senses.why: Old coaches traveled in fixed stretches, each one a stage.
senses.whyCN: 旧时马车按固定路段行进，每段即一个 stage。

senses.title: To present a play or event
senses.definition: to organize and present a play, show, or public event
senses.definitionCN: 组织并呈现戏剧、演出或公共活动
senses.example: The school staged a play about the old town.
senses.exampleCN: 学校上演了一部关于老城的戏剧。
senses.why: Putting on a show is putting it onto the raised floor.
senses.whyCN: 上演就是把演出放到抬高的台面上。

senses.title: To arrange something so it happens
senses.definition: to arrange an event deliberately, such as a protest or a photo
senses.definitionCN: 刻意安排某一事件，如抗议或摆拍照
senses.example: Workers staged a one-day strike.
senses.exampleCN: 工人发动了一天的罢工。
senses.why: The director's art is applied to real events, not only plays.
senses.whyCN: 导演的艺术被用到真实事件，而不只是戏剧。

senses.title: A level of rocket or engine sections
senses.definition: one of the separate sections of a rocket that fire and drop away in turn
senses.definitionCN: 火箭依次点火、脱离的独立舱段之一
senses.example: The first stage of the rocket fell into the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 火箭第一级坠入大海。
senses.why: The journey climbs in lifted sections, one after another.
senses.whyCN: 旅程逐级攀升，一段接一段。

senses.title: The scene where things happen
senses.definition: a place or situation where important events or actions occur
senses.definitionCN: 重要事件或活动发生的场所或情境
senses.example: The small country became the center stage of world politics.
senses.exampleCN: 这个小国成了世界政治的中心舞台。
senses.why: Life's big events need a floor to stand on, like actors do.
senses.whyCN: 人生的重大事件如演员一样需要立足的台面。

intro.en: Stage began as a French word for a stopping place on a road, then grew into a platform, a theater floor, and a step in time.
intro.cn: stage 起初是法语里指路边歇脚处的词，后来长出高台、剧场地板与时间阶段之义。

items.en: A form like staticum is generally thought to mean "a standing place"; detail is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为通俗拉丁语 staticum 一类形式意为「停留之所」；细节来源不确定。

items.en: Old French estage meant a dwelling or a stopping place.
items.cn: 古法语 estage 指住所或歇脚处。

items.en: Middle English stage meant a halt on a journey and a raised story or floor.
items.cn: 中古英语 stage 指行程的歇点与抬高的楼层。

items.en: The theater stage and the stagecoach fixed the travel and performance senses.
items.cn: 剧场舞台与驿站马车固定了旅行与表演两义。

items.en: Modern use adds process stages, rocket stages, and the verb to stage events.
items.cn: 现代用法增加进程阶段、火箭级与动词「举办」等。

note.en: Stage belongs to the stand-family of words and is often confused with the time-word stagger family.
note.cn: stage 属「站立」词族，且易与 stagger 等拼写相近词混淆。

entries.definition: to walk unsteadily or arrange times in intervals
entries.definitionCN: 蹒跚；使错开；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: behind the stage of a theater
entries.definitionCN: 后台；由 stage 加 back- 构成

entries.definition: the arrangement of scenery and scenes
a stage in a cycle of change
entries.definitionCN: 阶段；相位，强调周期中的一段

entries.definition: one action in a series
entries.definitionCN: 步骤；一步，强调序列中的单个动作

entries.definition: a raised level surface
to show or put something before people
entries.definitionCN: 呈现；展示，与 stage 的动词义相近

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for stage and its family.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 stage。

normal.en: stagecoach traveled in fixed stages: one road-section each day.
normal.cn: stagecoach 按固定 stage 行进：每日一段路。

normal.en: stage and stay both come from standing: the floor where actors stand.
normal.cn: stage 与 stay 同源于「站立」：演员站立的台面。

normal.en: set the stage for: the stage metaphor works for plans too.
normal.cn: set the stage for：舞台比喻同样用于计划。

normal.en: stage fright: fear that comes when you step onto the floor.
normal.cn: stage fright 怯场：登台那一刻生出的怕。

normal.en: Rocket stages drop away one by one, like stops on a road.
normal.cn: 火箭逐级脱离，如路上的一个驿站。

abstract.en: See an actor's foot landing on the wooden boards as lights rise.
abstract.cn: 看见灯光亮起时演员的脚踏上木板。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase where each step is a month of a project.
abstract.cn: 想象一段楼梯，每级台阶是项目的一个月。

abstract.en: Feel the coach stopping at dusk: one stage done, rest ahead.
abstract.cn: 感受马车黄昏歇脚：一段路完成，前路尚长。

examples.en: The band walked onto the stage as the crowd cheered.
examples.cn: 乐队在欢呼声中走上舞台。

examples.en: The disease has four stages, from mild to severe.
examples.cn: 这种病分四期，从轻到重。

examples.en: The union staged a rally outside the factory.
examples.cn: 工会在厂外组织了一场集会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯得之」——像「士登台」：士兵登上台阶之台，一阶一阶走到台前。

root: 一般认为 stage 经古法语 estage「住所、歇脚处」上溯至通俗拉丁语 staticum「站立之所」，与表示「站立」的词根相关；该路径为通常看法，细节来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: One standing place grows into a road stop, a raised floor, a step in time, and the art of putting things in front of people.
sensesIntro.cn: 一处站立之所长成歇脚处、高台、时间的一级台阶，以及把事物推到人前的艺术。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a raised floor where things stand to be seen
core.cn: 核心意象：让人与物立于其上被看见的高台

branches.en: time and roads divided into standing places
branches.cn: 被切成「站立之所」的时间与路途

branches.en: the literal and figurative theater floor
branches.cn: 字面与比喻的剧场台面

branches.en: putting plays and events onto the floor
branches.cn: 把戏剧与事件搬上台面

branches.en: a journey built of lifted sections
branches.cn: 由抬升舱段构成的旅程

branches.en: the everyday process sense

intro.en: Stage builds compounds easily because it names both a place and a step.
intro.cn: stage 既指地点又指步骤，故极易构成复合词。

latinIntro.en: Its assumed Latin source staticum joins the wide stand-family, kin to stay and state.
latinIntro.cn: 其假定的拉丁来源 staticum 属庞大的「站立」词族，与 stay、state 为亲。

items.example: The actors waited backstage in silence.
items.exampleCN: 演员们安静地在后台等待。

items.meaning: a horse-drawn coach running in stages
items.example: A stagecoach crossed the prairie weekly.
items.exampleCN: 驿站马车每周横越一次草原。

items.example: She overcame her stage fright after years.
items.exampleCN: 多年后她克服了怯场。

items.example: The spacecraft has three stages.
items.exampleCN: 这艘航天器分三级。

items.example: The staging of the final scene was brilliant.
items.exampleCN: 终场一幕的调度非常出色。

items.example: Climate is now center stage in talks.
items.exampleCN: 气候如今成为谈判的中心议题。

items.meaning: to remain standing in a place
items.example: Stay on stage until the lights dim.
items.exampleCN: 灯暗之前留在台上。

items.example: The deal set the stage for growth.
items.exampleCN: 这笔交易为增长铺平了道路。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ing 构成，义为「舞台布置；分期」
由 back- 加本词构成，义为「在后台」
由本词加 coach 构成，义为「驿站马车」

definition_zh: 楼梯的一级；台阶（常用复数指整段楼梯）
definition_en: one step in a set of steps for going up or down between levels, usually used in the plural to mean a staircase
core_image: 一级一级往上的踏板——每一级都把人抬高一点
scene: 老宅的楼梯在脚下吱吱作响。He counted every stair as he climbed to the attic.
sceneCN: 这里 stair 是「楼梯的一级」（第 1 个义项：上下楼的单个踏步）；句意为他上阁楼时一级一级数着台阶。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 case 构成，义为「楼梯（整体结构）」
由本词加 way 构成，义为「楼梯通道」
由本词加 well 构成，义为「楼梯井」

senses.title: One step of a staircase
senses.definition: a single horizontal step for climbing between two levels
senses.definitionCN: 在两个高度之间攀爬的单个踏步
senses.example: The third stair from the bottom creaks.
senses.exampleCN: 从下面数第三级会吱嘎响。
senses.why: Each board lifts the foot one small height at a time.
senses.whyCN: 每块踏板一次把脚抬高一小段。

senses.title: The whole set of steps
senses.definition: in the plural, the full series of steps connecting two floors
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式指连接两层楼的整段梯级
senses.example: The children raced down the stairs to breakfast.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们跑下楼梯去吃早饭。
senses.why: One step after another becomes the whole ladder of the house.
senses.whyCN: 一级接一级便构成房子里整条登高的梯。

senses.title: Levels of rank or progress
senses.definition: a figurative level in rising through rank or achievement
senses.definitionCN: 比喻职位或成就逐步上升中的一层
senses.example: This job is the first stair to a bigger career.
senses.exampleCN: 这份工作是通向更大事业的第一级。
senses.why: Rising in life climbs as the foot does: one level at a time.
senses.whyCN: 人生攀升与脚步一样：一次一层。

senses.title: A hidden or private way
senses.definition: in back stairs, a private or secret route, also for secret influence
senses.definitionCN: back stairs 指不公开的通道，也指暗中影响
senses.example: The servants used the back stairs to stay unseen.
senses.exampleCN: 仆人们走后楼梯以不被人看见。
senses.why: Steps hidden at the back of a house let people move unseen.
senses.whyCN: 藏在宅后的梯级让人不被察觉地走动。

intro.en: Stair is a pure Germanic climbing word: it always meant the board that lifts your foot, nothing more.
intro.cn: stair 是纯粹的日耳曼「攀爬」词：它始终只指抬起脚步的踏板。

items.en: A root meaning "to climb, stride" is generally reconstructed; deeper detail is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为词根表示「攀爬、迈步」；更深细节来源不确定。

items.en: Germanic formed words for climbing and stepping, kin to stile.
items.cn: 日耳曼语形成攀爬与迈步之词，与 stile（梯磴）同亲。

items.en: Old English stæger meant a step or ladder for climbing.
items.cn: 古英语 stæger 指攀爬用的踏步或梯子。

items.en: The plural stairs became the usual way to speak of the whole staircase.
items.cn: 复数 stairs 渐成指称整段楼梯的常用说法。

items.en: Compounds like staircase and stairwell fixed the family in modern buildings.
items.cn: staircase、stairwell 等复合词使该词族固定于现代建筑。

note.en: Stair heads a building family and sounds like the unrelated stare.
note.cn: stair 领衔建筑词族，且与不相关的 stare 发音相同。

entries.definition: to look at something long and fixedly
entries.definitionCN: 凝视；与 stair 同音但词源不同

entries.definition: steps for crossing a fence, same Germanic root
the whole structure of steps
entries.definitionCN: 楼梯整体；由 stair 加 case 构成

entries.definition: one movement or surface of walking
two rails with rungs for climbing
entries.definitionCN: 梯子；可移动的攀爬工具

entries.definition: a moving staircase
one bar of a ladder

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for stair and its family.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 stair。

normal.en: stair sounds like stare: climb, don't just look.
normal.cn: stair 与 stare 同音：要攀爬，别只是盯着看。

normal.en: staircase = stair + case, the boxed whole of the steps.
normal.cn: staircase = stair + case，装着梯级的「盒」。

normal.en: a flight of stairs: one connected run of climbing.
normal.cn: a flight of stairs：一整段相连的攀爬。

normal.en: back stairs: the hidden steps behind the grand front ones.
normal.cn: back stairs：气派前梯背后的暗梯。

normal.en: stairwell is the open shaft the stairs spiral around.
normal.cn: stairwell 是楼梯盘旋其中的竖井。

abstract.en: Feel each board rise under your shoe, one by one.
abstract.cn: 感受鞋底之下一级一级抬起的踏板。

abstract.en: Hear the creak of the third step every single time.
abstract.cn: 每次都听见第三级的吱嘎声。

abstract.en: See the top stair appear like a horizon you reach.
abstract.cn: 看见最上一级如可抵达的地平线般浮现。

examples.en: She swept every stair from the cellar to the attic.
examples.cn: 她把从地窖到阁楼的每级台阶都扫了一遍。

examples.en: A flight of stone stairs led up to the tower gate.
examples.cn: 一段石阶通向塔楼大门。

examples.en: Promotion came one stair at a time, never two.
examples.cn: 晋升一级一级来，从不连跳两级。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯黛尔」——像「斯台儿」：一小小的台阶儿，斯斯文文一级级往上。

sensesIntro.en: Stair keeps one image: the single board that lifts the foot, which the plural stretches into the whole climb.
sensesIntro.cn: stair 只有一个意象：抬起脚步的单块踏板；复数把它拉成整段攀爬。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one board that lifts the foot upward
core.cn: 核心意象：把脚向上抬起的一块踏板

steps hidden at the back

intro.cn: stair 是短小的日耳曼词，其词族以整词复合构成。

latinIntro.en: Stair has no Latin relatives; it never borrowed, it only compounded.
latinIntro.cn: stair 没有拉丁同族词；它从不借词，只做复合。

items.meaning: the framed structure holding the steps
items.example: The spiral staircase fills the tower.
items.exampleCN: 螺旋楼梯占满塔楼。

items.example: The stairway was blocked by boxes.
items.exampleCN: 梯道被箱子堵住了。

items.example: Light falls through the stairwell.
items.exampleCN: 光从楼梯井洒下。

items.example: Maids carried trays up the back stairs.
items.exampleCN: 女佣端着托盘走上后楼梯。

items.example: Take the up stairs, not the lift.
items.exampleCN: 走上行梯，别乘电梯。

items.example: A red stair-carpet ran the whole flight.
items.exampleCN: 红楼梯地毯铺满整段楼梯。

items.example: Climb the stile to reach the field.
items.exampleCN: 翻过梯磴到达田地。

items.example: She climbed a flight of stairs daily.
items.exampleCN: 她每天爬一段楼梯。

definition_zh: 桩；赌注；利害关系；股份；赌上；用桩支撑
definition_en: a pointed post fixed in the ground, the money or importance risked in a contest or plan, or a share in something
core_image: 一根钉进土里的尖木桩——既是界线，也是押上的筹码
scene: 菜园边的泥土松软，园丁手里握着几根木桩。The gardener drove a stake into the soil to tie the young tomato plants.
sceneCN: 这里 stake 是「木桩」（第 1 个义项：打进土里的尖木柱）；句意为园丁把木桩钉进土里用来绑幼番茄苗。

pos.zh: 名词：桩；赌注；利害关系；股份

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 holder 构成，义为「利益相关者；股东」
由本词加 out 构成，义为「（警方）监视守候」

senses.title: A pointed post fixed in the ground
senses.definition: a strong pointed wooden or metal post driven into the ground to hold or mark something
senses.definitionCN: 打入地中用来固定或标记的尖木柱或金属柱
senses.example: They tied the tent ropes to iron stakes.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把帐篷绳系在铁桩上。
senses.why: The sharp end bites the earth and stands as a fixed point.
senses.whyCN: 尖头咬进土里，立成一个固定的点。

senses.title: Money or value risked in a bet
senses.definition: an amount of money or value placed at risk in a game or bet
senses.definitionCN: 在赌博或竞赛中押上的钱或价值
senses.example: He lost his whole week's pay on one stake.
senses.exampleCN: 他一把赌注输掉了一周的工钱。
senses.why: The coin is fixed like a post: it stays where it is put until the game ends.
senses.whyCN: 钱币像桩一样钉在那里，直到赌局结束。

senses.title: Something that can be won or lost
senses.definition: the importance or value that depends on the result of an event
senses.definitionCN: 取决于某事件结果的重要性或价值
senses.example: Thousands of jobs are at stake in the deal.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔交易事关数千个工作岗位。
senses.why: What is fixed in place can be gained or lost when the ground shifts.
senses.whyCN: 钉牢之物会随地面变动而得或失。

senses.title: A share in a business or plan
senses.definition: a share of ownership or interest in a company, project, or outcome
senses.definitionCN: 对公司、项目或结果的拥有份额或利益
senses.example: She bought a twenty percent stake in the startup.
senses.exampleCN: 她买下了这家初创公司百分之二十的股份。
senses.why: A stake in the ground marks your claim; a stake in a firm marks your share.
senses.whyCN: 地上的桩标出你的地界；公司的股标出你的份额。

senses.title: A post used in punishment or burning
senses.definition: a post to which a person was once tied for punishment
senses.definitionCN: 旧时用来绑缚受罚者受火刑的柱子
senses.example: In old stories, witches were burned at the stake.
senses.exampleCN: 在古老的故事里，女巫被绑上火刑柱烧死。
senses.why: The fixed post becomes the fixed place of punishment.
senses.whyCN: 固定的桩成为固定的刑罚之地。

senses.title: To risk or bet something
senses.definition: to put money, reputation, or life at risk on a result
senses.definitionCN: 把金钱、名誉或性命押在某个结果上
senses.example: He staked his whole reputation on the new method.
senses.exampleCN: 他把全部声誉押在新方法上。
senses.why: To stake is to fix your value in place and let the game decide.
senses.whyCN: 赌上就是把你的价值钉在原地，听凭结果裁决。

senses.title: To support a plant with a post
senses.definition: to tie a young plant to a post so it grows upright
senses.definitionCN: 把幼苗绑在柱上使其直立生长
senses.example: The beans were staked before the storm arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨来临前豆苗已被架上支柱。
senses.why: The post holds the weak plant upright, as it holds tents and claims.
senses.whyCN: 桩撑起弱小的植株，正如它撑住帐篷与地界。

intro.en: Stake is a Germanic word for a pointed post, and the betting sense grew from the fixed post of a game's wager.
intro.cn: stake 是日耳曼语中「尖桩」一词，赌博义由赌局中钉定的筹码发展而来。

items.en: A root meaning "to stick, be sharp" is generally reconstructed; detail is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为词根表示「刺入、尖锐」；细节来源不确定。

items.en: Germanic built words for pointed posts, kin to steak and stock.
items.cn: 日耳曼语形成指尖桩的词，与 steak、stock 同亲。

items.en: Old English staca meant a pin or pointed post.
items.cn: 古英语 staca 指钉子或尖桩。

items.en: The betting sense arose: the wager fixed in place like a post.
items.cn: 赌博义产生：赌注如木桩般钉定。

items.en: Business shares, risk, and stakes in games all extended the same image.
items.cn: 商业股份、风险与赌局筹码沿用同一意象。

note.en: Stake shares sound with steak and stock, and one family with post-words.
note.cn: stake 与 steak、stock 音近，并与桩类词同族。

entries.definition: a thick slice of meat
entries.definitionCN: 牛排；与 stake 同音但词源不同

entries.definition: a thin branch or rod, same sharp-point family
supply, shares, or a tree trunk
entries.definitionCN: 存货；股票；树干；音近但词义不同

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for stake and its bets.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 stake。

normal.en: stake and steak sound the same: meat on a grill, post in the ground.
normal.cn: stake 与 steak 同音：一在烤架，一在土里。

normal.en: at stake means everything can be lost, like a fixed post shaken.
normal.cn: at stake 表示可能尽失，如木桩被撼动。

normal.en: stakeholder: whoever holds a stake holds an interest.
normal.cn: stakeholder：执「股」者即有利害关系者。

normal.en: raise the stakes: drive the post deeper, risk more.
normal.cn: raise the stakes：把桩打得更深，押上更多。

normal.en: Tent ropes and tomato plants both lean on stakes.
normal.cn: 帐篷绳与番茄苗都靠 stake 支撑。

abstract.en: Hear the thud of a mallet driving a post into the earth.
abstract.cn: 听木槌把桩打入土中的闷响。

abstract.en: See coins stacked beside a campfire game, fixed until dawn.
abstract.cn: 看见篝火游戏旁堆好的钱币，钉定到天亮。

abstract.en: Feel a young tomato leaning, then standing straight against its post.
abstract.cn: 感受幼番茄由歪到直，倚住支柱站定。

examples.en: The farmers staked the fence line before planting.
examples.cn: 农民在种植前先沿线打桩。

examples.en: More than medals were at stake in the final match.
examples.cn: 决赛中利害攸关的不只是奖牌。

examples.en: Investors staked millions on the untested technology.
examples.cn: 投资者把数百万押在未经检验的技术上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯得克」——像「死得磕」：桩子死死磕进地里，磕上多少赌注也不挪。

sensesIntro.en: One pointed post in the ground grows into bets, business shares, punishment posts, and plant supports.
sensesIntro.cn: 一根钉入土中的尖桩长出赌注、股份、刑桩与植物支柱诸义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sharp post fixed in the ground as a claim
core.cn: 核心意象：作为标记钉进土里的尖桩

branches.en: posts that hold tents, plants, and lines
branches.cn: 撑住帐篷、植物与边线的桩

intro.cn: stake 是光杆日耳曼名词；其词族靠复合词与 -holder 搭配扩展。

latinIntro.en: Stake has no Latin relatives; the sharp-point family is all Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: stake 没有拉丁同族词；「尖刺」词族全属日耳曼语。

items.meaning: a person with an interest or share
items.example: Every stakeholder signed the agreement.
items.exampleCN: 每位利益相关者都签了协议。

items.meaning: a police watch from a fixed position
items.example: The stakeout lasted three nights.
items.exampleCN: 那次守候持续了三夜。

items.example: Collect dry sticks for the fire.
items.exampleCN: 捡些干枝来生火。

items.meaning: stake body, stake bed of a truck
items.example: Hay rode on the truck's stake bed.
items.exampleCN: 干草装在卡车的桩栏车斗里。

items.meaning: the prize or risk of a contest
items.example: The stakes of the race were doubled.
items.exampleCN: 比赛的赌金翻倍了。

items.example: Peace itself was at stake.
items.exampleCN: 和平本身都危在旦夕。

items.example: Grill the steak for six minutes.
items.exampleCN: 牛排烤六分钟。

items.meaning: a horse race with entry money pooled
items.example: They entered the colt in a stakes race.
items.exampleCN: 他们给这匹小雄马报名了有奖金的赛马。

definition_zh: 摊位；畜栏；熄火；拖延；失速
definition_en: a small enclosed place for an animal, a market stand, or to stop running or delay on purpose
core_image: 一格被围住的小空间——牲口站进去、货摆出来、引擎也卡在这里停下
scene: 集市清晨的木摊架刚搭好。She bought two baskets of apples at a fruit stall near the gate.
sceneCN: 这里 stall 是「摊位」（第 3 个义项：集市上的售货台）；句意为她在门口附近的水果摊买了两篮苹果。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ing 构成，义为「拖延；（机）失速」
由本词加 holder 构成，义为「摊主」

senses.title: A small place where an animal stands
senses.definition: an enclosed space in a barn or stable for one animal
senses.definitionCN: 厩舍中围出的供一头牲口站立的小格
senses.example: Each cow stood calmly in its own stall.
senses.exampleCN: 每头牛安静地站在自己的栏位里。
senses.why: The animal is fixed in one small standing place.
senses.whyCN: 牲口被固定在一处小小的站立之所。

senses.title: A small room or seat divided by walls
senses.definition: a small compartment, as in a bathroom or a church seat
senses.definitionCN: 被隔出的小间，如浴室隔间或教堂座椅
senses.example: The office has three toilet stalls down the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 走廊尽头有三个厕所隔间。
senses.why: One standing place, walled off for a person.
senses.whyCN: 为一个人隔出的站立之所。

senses.title: A stand where goods are sold
senses.definition: a table or open-fronted shop in a market
senses.definitionCN: 市场中的售货台或敞面小店
senses.example: A book stall stood at the corner of the market.
senses.exampleCN: 市场拐角有个书摊。
senses.why: The seller's goods stand fixed in one open box, like animals in a stall.
senses.whyCN: 货品像栏中之兽一样固定在一个敞格内。

senses.title: To stop an engine by sudden braking or wrong gear
senses.definition: to stop an engine suddenly because of wrong gear use or a blocked wheel
senses.definitionCN: 因挡位不当或车轮受阻使发动机突然停转
senses.example: The learner driver stalled at every red light.
senses.exampleCN: 新手司机每个红灯都熄火。
senses.why: The engine is held still, like an animal fixed in its stall.
senses.whyCN: 引擎被卡住不动，如牲口被拴在栏中。

senses.title: To delay on purpose
senses.definition: to delay or hold up an answer, decision, or process deliberately
senses.definitionCN: 故意推迟答复、决定或进程
senses.example: The lawyer stalled for time before the trial.
senses.exampleCN: 律师在开庭前设法拖延时间。
senses.why: Holding something in a fixed place keeps it from moving forward.
senses.whyCN: 把事情按在原地不动，即是拖延。

senses.title: To lose lifting speed in flight
senses.definition: to stop producing lift because the airflow over the wings breaks
senses.definitionCN: 因机翼气流破坏而失去升力
senses.example: The plane stalled and dropped sharply.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机失速急坠。
senses.why: The wings can no longer keep the plane going upward; it falls still.
senses.whyCN: 机翼无法再托起飞机，机身停坠。

intro.en: Stall comes straight from Germanic words for a standing place, the same root family as stable's barn.
intro.cn: stall 直接来自日耳曼语的「站立之所」，与 stable（马厩）同根同族。

items.en: The stand-root, meaning "to stand", underlies the family.
items.cn: 表示「站立」的词根是整个词族的基础。

items.en: Germanic formed stall for a fixed standing place for animals.
items.cn: 日耳曼语以 stall 指牲口的固定站位。

items.en: Old English steall meant a place to stand, a stall, or a seat.
items.cn: 古英语 steall 指站立处、栏位或座位。

items.en: The market stand sense and the church seat sense spread.
items.cn: 集市摊位义与教堂座位义扩展。

items.en: Engine stalling and flight stalling gave the verb its modern force.
items.cn: 熄火与失速赋予动词现代用法。

note.en: Stall shares its standing-place root with stable and store, and sounds close to still.
note.cn: stall 与 stable、store 同享「站立之所」词根，且与 still 音近。

entries.definitionCN: 马厩；与 stall 同源于「站立」词根

normal.en: stall and stable share the stand-root: both are standing places.
normal.cn: stall 与 stable 同根：都是「站立之所」。

normal.en: A market stall is one open box, like one animal stall.
normal.cn: 集市摊位是一个敞格，恰如一个畜栏。

normal.en: stall for time: hold the answer in one place.
normal.cn: stall for time：把答复按在原地。

normal.en: Engine stalls when it cannot keep turning.
normal.cn: 引擎转不动就 stall（熄火）。

normal.en: Planes stall when wings stop lifting.
normal.cn: 机翼失去升力飞机即 stall（失速）。

abstract.en: See one cow in one wooden box, calm and fixed.
abstract.cn: 看见一头牛安静地立在一个木格里。

abstract.en: Watch an apple seller open his wooden box at dawn.
abstract.cn: 看见果贩清晨支起他的木摊。

abstract.en: Feel the car shudder and stop at the lights.
abstract.cn: 感受汽车在红灯前抖动、熄火。

examples.en: The market stall sold fresh fish every Saturday.
examples.cn: 那个集市摊位每周六卖鲜鱼。

examples.en: Don't stall the answer; we need a decision today.
examples.cn: 别拖着不答；我们今天就要决定。

examples.en: He stalled the car twice during the driving test.
examples.cn: 他考驾照时熄火两次。
