intro.en: Stall is a short stand-root word; compounds carry its meanings outward.
intro.cn: stall 是短小的「站立」词根词，其诸义靠复合词向外延展。

latinIntro.en: Stall shares Germanic roots with stable and store; no Latin entry applies here.
latinIntro.cn: stall 与 stable、store 共享日耳曼词根；此处无拉丁同族条目。

items.example: The stallholder packed up at dusk.
items.exampleCN: 摊主黄昏时收摊。

items.meaning: the act of delaying or losing lift
items.example: Repeated stalling ruined the engine.
items.exampleCN: 反复熄火毁了引擎。

items.example: Each room has its own shower stall.
items.exampleCN: 每间房都有独立淋浴隔间。

items.example: They sat in the front stalls.
items.exampleCN: 他们坐在前排正座。

items.meaning: a horse building from the same root
items.example: Stable and stall both mean a standing place.
items.exampleCN: stable 与 stall 都指站立之所。

items.meaning: stall something up, block it in place
items.example: Traffic stalled up at the bridge.
items.exampleCN: 交通在桥上堵停了。

items.example: The lake lay still at dawn.
items.exampleCN: 黎明时湖面平静。

items.example: A phone booth stood on the corner.
items.exampleCN: 街角立着一部电话亭。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ing 构成，义为「拖延；失速」
由本词加 holder 构成，义为「摊主」

definition_zh: 邮票；印章；图章；踩；盖章；贴邮票；铭记
definition_en: a small printed label for letters, a tool or mark made by pressing, or to put the foot down heavily
core_image: 重重一压——脚踩进土里、印章压在纸上、邮票贴上信封
scene: 信纸写完，抽屉里取出一枚新邮票。He licked the stamp and pressed it onto the corner of the envelope.
sceneCN: 这里 stamp 是「邮票」（第 1 个义项：贴在信封上的印刷小票）；句为他舔了舔邮票，把它贴在信封一角。

pos.zh: 名词：邮票；印章；压印；跺脚
动词：盖章；贴邮票；踩；铭刻

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ed 构成，义为「盖了章的；压印过的」
由本词加-ing 构成，义为「冲压；盖章动作」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「盖章者；冲压机」

senses.title: A small printed label for postage
senses.definition: a small printed piece of paper stuck to a letter to show postage paid
senses.definitionCN: 贴在信件上表示邮资已付的小印刷纸片
senses.example: I need a stamp to mail this birthday card.
senses.exampleCN: 我需要一张邮票寄这张生日卡。
senses.why: The post office presses its mark on paper; the pressed label is born.
senses.whyCN: 邮局把印记压在纸上，压印的小票便诞生了。

senses.title: A tool or mark made by pressing
senses.definition: a tool that presses a design onto paper, or the mark it leaves
senses.definitionCN: 把图案压印到纸上的工具，或留下的印记
senses.example: The clerk hit the document with an official stamp.
senses.exampleCN: 职员在文件上盖了公章。
senses.why: Pressing leaves a design; the tool and the mark share one word.
senses.whyCN: 压印留下图案，工具与印记共用一词。

senses.title: To put the foot down heavily
senses.definition: to bring the foot down hard on the ground
senses.definitionCN: 用力把脚踩在地上
senses.example: She stamped her foot in anger.
senses.exampleCN: 她气得直跺脚。
senses.why: A heavy foot is a human seal pressed onto the floor.
senses.whyCN: 沉重的脚就是压向地面的人形印章。

senses.title: To print a mark officially
senses.definition: to press an official or identifying mark onto something
senses.definitionCN: 把官方或识别性印记压到某物上
senses.example: The visa was stamped into his passport.
senses.exampleCN: 签证章盖在了他的护照上。
senses.why: The tool from sense two becomes the action itself.
senses.whyCN: 第二义的印章工具化为动作本身。

senses.title: To fix an idea deeply on mind or history
senses.definition: to leave a lasting mark on someone's mind, an era, or a thing
senses.definitionCN: 在人的心中、时代或事物上留下持久的印记
senses.example: His years abroad stamped a new accent on his speech.
senses.exampleCN: 旅居多年给他的口音留下了深深的印记。
senses.why: A pressed mark stays; pressed ideas stay in minds the same way.
senses.whyCN: 压出的印痕会留存，压入的观念也长久留在心里。

senses.title: To crush or end completely
senses.definition: in stamp out, to destroy something firmly and completely
senses.definitionCN: stamp out 中指坚决彻底地消灭某事
senses.example: The city worked to stamp out littering.
senses.exampleCN: 市里努力杜绝乱丢垃圾。
senses.why: You end a fire by pressing it under your foot.
senses.whyCN: 把火踩灭在脚下，即是消灭。

intro.en: Stamp is a Germanic pressing word: every meaning comes from one heavy push that leaves a mark.
intro.cn: stamp 是日耳曼语的「压印」词：所有义项都来自一次留痕的重压。

items.en: A root meaning "to press, trample" is generally reconstructed; detail is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为词根表示「按压、踩踏」；细节来源不确定。

items.en: Germanic built stamp- words for pressing and trampling.
items.cn: 日耳曼语形成 stamp- 词族，指压印与踩踏。

items.en: Old English stampe and Old French estamper both meant to pound or press; the link is generally accepted.
items.cn: 古英语 stampe 与古法语 estamper 均指捣压；这一关联被普遍接受。

items.en: The seal, the pressed foot, and later the postage stamp fixed the senses.
items.cn: 印章、踩踏与后来的邮票先后固定诸义项。

items.en: Machine stamping, stamp duty, and stamp collecting extended use.
items.cn: 机器冲压、印花税与集 hobby 扩展了用法。

note.en: Stamp shares the pressing family with stomp and stamp, and sounds like the unrelated stump.
note.cn: stamp 与 stomp 同属按压词族，并与不相关的 stump 音近。

entries.definition: the base of a tree left after cutting
entries.definitionCN: 树桩；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: to tread heavily, American variant
a sudden rush of animals or crowd
entries.definitionCN: 狂奔；惊逃，由 stamp 加词尾构成

entries.definition: an official mark pressed onto documents
a mark left by pressing
to tread heavily on and crush
a piece of paper marked on an item
entries.definitionCN: 标签；与邮票同属贴印之物

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for stamp's pressing family.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 stamp 的按压词族。

normal.en: stamp and stomp: pressing paper, pressing ground.
normal.cn: stamp 与 stomp：一个压纸，一个踏地。

normal.en: A rubber stamp presses, so does a heavy foot.
normal.cn: 橡皮章要压，沉重的脚也要压。

normal.en: stamp out a fire: end it underfoot.
normal.cn: stamp out 一脚踩灭火苗，即彻底消灭。

normal.en: Stamp duty: a tax born from pressed seals on papers.
normal.cn: 印花税源自盖印文件。

normal.en: stamp collecting grew the moment pressed labels became valuable.
normal.cn: 压印的小票一旦珍贵，集邮随之兴起。

abstract.en: Hear the boom of a foot on a wooden floor.
abstract.cn: 听木地板上跺脚的一声闷响。

abstract.en: See red ink bloom under a falling seal.
abstract.cn: 看见印章落下时红印晕开。

abstract.en: Feel the little ridged edge of a postage stamp under a thumb.
abstract.cn: 感受指腹下邮票细密的锯齿边。

examples.en: He stamped the date on every page of the ledger.
examples.cn: 他在账簿每页都盖了日期章。

examples.en: The crowd stamped and clapped until the band returned.
examples.cn: 观众跺脚拍手，直到乐队返场。

examples.en: New laws aim to stamp out false advertising.
examples.cn: 新法规旨在杜绝虚假广告。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯带姆普」——像「死踏！砰！」：重重一踏砰然作响，脚印印章同时留下。

root: 古英语 stampe 与古法语 estamper「捣压」相互影响，属日耳曼按压词族；一般认为出自表示「按压、踩踏」的印欧词根，确切形式来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Every stamp is one heavy press: a foot on earth, a seal on paper, a label on a letter, an idea on a mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个 stamp 都是一次重压：脚踏泥土、印章落纸、邮票贴信、观念印心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one heavy press that leaves a lasting mark
core.cn: 核心意象：一次留下持久印记的重压

branches.en: official marks pressed on paper
branches.cn: 压印在纸上的官方印记

branches.en: the tool and the mark it leaves
the heavy foot that ends things
marks pressed into minds and eras
branches.cn: 压入心间与时代的印记

branches.en: the postage label sense

intro.en: Stamp compounds freely because pressing meets paper, feet, taxes, and machines.
intro.cn: stamp 因按压触及纸张、脚、税与机器而极易复合。

latinIntro.en: Stamp is Germanic; Old French estamper only reinforced it, so Latin entries are empty.
latinIntro.cn: stamp 属日耳曼语源；古法语 estamper 只起强化作用，拉丁条目为空。

items.example: Each stamped invoice passed the audit.
items.exampleCN: 每张盖章发票都通过了审计。

items.meaning: one who stamps, or the machine
items.example: The stamper marked each ticket.
items.exampleCN: 冲压机在每张票上打记号。

items.meaning: a running panic, from Spanish estampida
items.example: The thunder started a stampede of cattle.
items.exampleCN: 雷声引起牛群狂奔。

items.example: Approval needs more than a rubber stamp.
items.exampleCN: 批准不只是走个橡皮图章。

items.example: A postage stamp went up in price again.
items.exampleCN: 邮票又涨价了。

items.meaning: a tax paid by pressed seals
items.example: Stamp duty rises with house prices.
items.exampleCN: 印花税随房价上涨。

items.example: They vowed to stamp out bribery.
items.exampleCN: 他们誓言杜绝贿赂。

items.meaning: the heavy step of a foot
items.example: A foot stamp shook the whole floor.
items.exampleCN: 一脚跺得整层楼直颤。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ed 构成，义为「盖了章的」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「盖章者；冲压机」

definition_zh: 站立；忍受；位于； withstand；摊位；看台；立场
definition_en: to be on your feet, to be located, to tolerate something, or a place, position, or opinion that is fixed
core_image: 双脚钉在地面——既是不倒的身体，也是不变的立场
scene: 长途大巴终于停在站前。Passengers stood up one by one to collect their bags from the shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 stand 是「站起来」（第 1 个义项：由坐而立）；句意为乘客们陆续起身从行李架取包。

pos.zh: 动词：站；忍受；位于；保持有效
名词：站立；摊位；看台；立场

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ing 构成，义为「地位；持续时间；站立」
由 under- 加本词构成，义为「理解；明白」
由 with- 加本词构成，义为「抵挡；承受」
与本词同源于 stand 词族，义为「标准；旗帜标杆」

senses.title: To be on your feet
senses.definition: to support your body on your feet, or to rise from a seat
senses.definitionCN: 以双脚支撑身体，或由坐而起
senses.example: Everyone stood when the judge entered.
senses.exampleCN: 法官入庭时全体起立。
senses.why: The body is fixed upright like a post in the ground.
senses.whyCN: 身体如插在地上的柱子般直立。

senses.title: To be located or remain in a place
senses.definition: to exist in a place, or to remain in a stated position
senses.definitionCN: 存在于某处，或保持于某种状态
senses.example: An old tower stands on the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 山上矗立着一座古塔。
senses.why: What stands on its base stays where it is.
senses.whyCN: 立于基座之物便留在原地。

senses.title: To tolerate or endure
senses.definition: to bear or accept something unpleasant, usually with can or could
senses.definitionCN: 承受令人不快之事，常与 can/could 连用
senses.example: I can't stand loud chewing.
senses.exampleCN: 我受不了大声咀嚼的声音。
senses.why: To stand firm under pressure is to bear it.
senses.whyCN: 在压力下站稳即是承受。

senses.title: To remain valid or unchanged
senses.definition: to stay true, valid, or in force, as a record or agreement
senses.definitionCN: 保持真实、有效或继续生效，如纪录或协议
senses.example: The court ruled that the contract still stands.
senses.exampleCN: 法院裁定合同仍然有效。
senses.why: A thing left standing has not been knocked down.
senses.whyCN: 依然立着的东西就没有被推倒。

senses.title: A small shop or structure
senses.definition: a small open structure where goods are sold or shown
senses.definitionCN: 售卖或陈列商品的小型敞开构筑物
senses.example: A lemonade stand opened outside the school.
senses.exampleCN: 学校外开了个柠檬水小摊。
senses.why: The structure literally stands on the street.
senses.whyCN: 棚摊就「立」在街边。

senses.title: An opinion or position taken
senses.definition: a firm position or opinion, especially one declared publicly
senses.definitionCN: 坚定的立场或观点，尤指公开表明者
senses.example: The senator took a strong stand against the bill.
senses.exampleCN: 参议员对法案表明强硬立场。
senses.why: An opinion you refuse to move from is a footing you stand on.
senses.whyCN: 不肯挪动的观点，就是你站立的立足点。

senses.title: Rows of seats for watchers
senses.definition: a large raised structure with rows of seats at a sports ground
senses.definitionCN: 体育场上带成排座位的大型看台
senses.example: The new stand holds twenty thousand fans.
senses.exampleCN: 新看台可容纳两万名球迷。
senses.why: The structure is built to stand and to let crowds stand or sit on it.
senses.whyCN: 看台被建得立得住，也让观众立于其上。

intro.en: Stand is one of the oldest English verbs, growing from the same stand-root that gives stable, stall, and state.
intro.cn: stand 是英语最古老的动词之一，与 stable、stall、state 同出一个「站立」词根。

items.en: The root *sta-, "to stand", is securely reconstructed.
items.cn: 词根 *sta-「站立」的重构被公认可靠。

items.en: Germanic standan carried the plain meaning of being on the feet.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 standan 承载了双脚站立的朴素义。

items.en: Old English standan meant to stand, remain, or hold a position.
items.cn: 古英语 standan 意为站立、停留或守住位置。

items.en: The market stand and the bearing of pressure grew in daily use.
items.cn: 摊位与承受压力义在日常使用中生长。

items.en: Phrasal verbs like stand out, stand for, stand up fixed the modern pattern.
items.cn: stand out、stand for、stand up 等短语定形于现代英语。

note.en: Stand anchors the whole stand-family, and sounds like the unrelated staunch.
note.cn: stand 是整个「站立」词族的锚，且与不相关的 staunch 音近。

entries.definition: loyal and firm in support
entries.definitionCN: 坚定的；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: to grasp meaning, same stand- root
rank or duration
entries.definitionCN: 地位；持续，由 stand 派生

entries.definition: to bear patiently over time
to allow or accept without complaint
a place or an attitude taken
a small stall or enclosure
entries.definitionCN: 货摊；与 stand 的摊位义相近

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for stand and its family.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 stand。

normal.en: stood, stood: the old strong verb never bends.
normal.cn: 过去式 stood 不变，正如站立不弯。

normal.en: with + stand = withstand: standing against force.
normal.cn: with + stand = withstand「抵挡」。

normal.en: under + stand = understand: to stand beneath and take it in.
normal.cn: under + stand = understand「理解」。

normal.en: stand out: rise above the crowd of standing bodies.
normal.cn: stand out：从站立的人群中凸出。

normal.en: I can't stand it: you cannot keep standing under it.
normal.cn: can't stand：在它下面站不住，即受不了。

abstract.en: Feel both soles gripping the ground like roots.
abstract.cn: 感受双脚像树根一样抓紧地面。

abstract.en: See a lemonade stand waiting on the sunny corner.
abstract.cn: 看见阳光街角的柠檬水小摊。

abstract.en: Hear the crowd roar from the standing terraces.
abstract.cn: 听看台上人群的吼声。

examples.en: The whole class stood to greet the visitor.
examples.cn: 全班起立迎接来宾。

examples.en: Their record still stands after twenty years.
examples.cn: 二十年后他们的纪录依然保持。

examples.en: She took a firm stand on climate policy.
examples.cn: 她在气候政策上立场坚定。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯丹德」——像「死钉的」：死死钉在地上，站定不动，立场不移。

root: 古英语 standan「站立」，出自印欧词根 *sta-「站立」（重构形式可靠），与 stable、stall、state、stay 同族。

sensesIntro.en: From the plain act of standing, stand grows into enduring, standing firm, market stands, and the stands of a stadium.
sensesIntro.cn: stand 从「站立」长出忍受、坚守、街边摊位与球场看台。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fixed upright on the ground, unmoved
core.cn: 核心意象：直立钉在地面，不为所动

branches.en: bodies and buildings on their feet
branches.cn: 站立的人与矗立的建筑

branches.en: bearing pressure and staying valid
structures built to stand for selling and watching
branches.cn: 供售卖与观赛而立的构筑物

branches.en: an opinion fixed like a footing
branches.cn: 如立足点般固定的观点

branches.en: the plain body sense

intro.en: Stand is the trunk of the greatest word-family in English: the stand-root.
intro.cn: stand 是英语最大词族「站立词根」的主干。

latinIntro.en: Latin stare, from the same PIE root, gives stable, stall, state, and stay their force.
latinIntro.cn: 同源拉丁语 stare 给 stable、stall、state、stay 提供力量。

items.meaning: to grasp by standing under an idea
items.example: I finally understood the rule.
items.exampleCN: 我终于明白了这条规则。

items.example: The bridge withstood the flood.
items.exampleCN: 大桥顶住了洪水。

items.meaning: to be clearly better or different
items.example: Her essay stood out among hundreds.
items.exampleCN: 她的文章在数百篇中脱颖而出。

items.example: The dove stands for peace.
items.exampleCN: 鸽子象征和平。

items.meaning: the fixed thing to stand by
items.example: Safety standards rose last year.
items.exampleCN: 去年安全标准提高了。

items.meaning: rank, duration, or the act of standing
items.example: His standing in the club rose.
items.exampleCN: 他在俱乐部的地位上升了。

items.example: Latin stare is the twin of English stand.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 stare 是英语 stand 的孪生。

items.meaning: to stand near and be ready
items.example: Nurses stood by all night.
items.exampleCN: 护士整夜待命。

definition_zh: 标准；规格；水准；标准的；常规的；旗舰的
definition_en: a level of quality or measure used as a model, or usual and of the accepted kind
core_image: 一根立在广场中央的标杆——所有人抬头看它，量出自己的高低
scene: 质检员走进新车间，手里拿着卡尺。Every part must pass the factory standard before it leaves the line.
sceneCN: 这里 standard 是「标准」（第 1 个义项：衡量合格与否的基准）；句意为每个零件出厂前都必须达到厂里的标准。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加动词后缀构成，义为「使标准化」
由本词派生，义为「标准化」
由 sub- 加本词构成，义为「低于标准的」
由本词加 bearer 构成，义为「旗手；倡导者」

senses.title: A level of quality required
senses.definition: a required or agreed level of quality or achievement
senses.definitionCN: 被要求或公认的质量与成就水平
senses.example: Her work reaches a very high standard.
senses.exampleCN: 她的工作水准很高。
senses.why: The agreed measure stands in the middle for all to compare.
senses.whyCN: 公认的度量立在中间，供众人比较。

senses.title: An official unit or rule of measure
senses.definition: an official rule, unit, or specification that others follow
senses.definitionCN: 他人遵循的官方规则、单位或规格
senses.example: The new safety standard applies to all cars.
senses.exampleCN: 新安全标准适用于所有汽车。
senses.why: Weights and measures once stood as fixed objects of reference.
senses.whyCN: 度量衡最初以固定的参照物形式立在那里。

senses.title: A flag carried on a pole
senses.definition: a flag or emblem raised on a pole, especially in ceremonies or battle
senses.definitionCN: 立在杆上的旗帜或徽记，多用于仪式或战斗
senses.example: The knights followed the king's standard.
senses.exampleCN: 骑士们追随国王的军旗。
senses.why: The oldest sense: the standing pole that a group gathers under.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项：众人聚集其下的立杆。

senses.title: Usual and accepted
senses.definition: normal, usual, and of the accepted kind

senses.exampleCN: 房间配一张标准双人床。
senses.why: What matches the standing measure is ordinary and accepted.
senses.whyCN: 符合既立尺度之物便是寻常可接受的。

senses.title: A principle of conduct
senses.definition: a moral rule or level of behavior expected of people
senses.definitionCN: 对人的道德要求或行为水准
senses.example: Parents set the standards their children follow.
senses.exampleCN: 父母定下子女遵循的准则。
senses.why: Conduct is measured against a pole planted in the community.
senses.whyCN: 行为以插在社群中的标杆来衡量。

senses.title: The basic or unimproved version
senses.definition: the base model of a product before optional upgrades
senses.definitionCN: 产品未加选配的基础版本
senses.example: The standard version costs two thousand less.
senses.exampleCN: 标准版便宜两千元。
senses.why: The plain standing form, before anything is added to it.
senses.whyCN: 未加修饰的基础形态。

intro.en: Standard began as the standing flag a group gathered under, then became the fixed measure everyone compares to.
intro.cn: standard 起初是众人聚集其下的立旗，后成为人人比较的固定尺度。

items.en: The root *sta-, "to stand", underlies the word.
items.cn: 词根 *sta-「站立」为该词基础。

items.en: Old French estandart meant a standing flag; its link to stand is generally accepted, though some scholars debate details.
items.cn: 古法语 estandart 指立旗；与 stand 的关联被普遍接受，但细节有学者存疑。

items.en: Middle English standard first named the military flag.
items.cn: 中古英语 standard 最初指军旗。

items.en: The fixed measure sense grew from official weights standing in marketplaces.
items.cn: 固定尺度义由立于市场的官定度量生长。

items.en: Quality standards, standardized parts, and standard editions completed the modern range.
items.cn: 质量标准、标准化部件与标准版完成现代词义版图。

note.en: Standard stands in the stand-family and pairs with its opposite substandard.
note.cn: standard 属「站立」词族，并与 substandard 构成反义。

abstract.cn: 感受众人的目光转向同一个固定点。

examples.cn: 这座桥按国际安全标准建造。

examples.en: Knights raised their standard before the charge.
examples.cn: 骑士们在冲锋前竖起军旗。

examples.cn: 该市生活水平稳步提高。

branches.cn: 以标杆衡量的质量与品行

items.example: The firm standardized its packaging.
items.exampleCN: 该公司统一了包装。

items.example: Standardization cut costs by ten percent.
items.exampleCN: 标准化使成本降低一成。

items.example: Substandard wiring caused the fire.
items.exampleCN: 不合标准的线路引发火灾。

items.example: She was the standard-bearer of the movement.
items.exampleCN: 她是这场运动的旗手。

items.example: The -ard ending marks the fixed reference.
items.exampleCN: -ard 词尾标记固定参照物。

items.example: Living standards doubled in a decade.
items.exampleCN: 十年间生活水平翻番。

items.example: Critics accused them of double standards.

definition_zh: 星；恒星；明星；星号；主演； starred
definition_en: a burning ball of gas in the sky, a famous performer, or a small star-shaped mark used to show quality
core_image: 夜空里自燃发光的一点——既照着天，也照着舞台和评分表
scene: 夏夜的露营地里，孩子们躺在草地上仰望。They wished on the brightest star just before falling asleep.
sceneCN: 这里 star 是「星星」（第 1 个义项：夜空中发光的天体）；句意为他们在睡前对着最亮的星星许愿。

senses.title: A burning ball of gas in the sky
senses.definition: a huge ball of burning gas seen as a point of light at night
senses.definitionCN: 夜里看去为发光小点的巨大燃烧气体球
senses.example: The desert sky was full of stars.
senses.exampleCN: 沙漠的夜空繁星满天。
senses.why: The oldest sense: the fixed lights we steer and wish by.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项：供人导航与许愿的固定光点。

senses.title: A famous performer
senses.definition: a famous and admired performer in film, music, or sport
senses.definitionCN: 影视、音乐或体育中著名且受推崇的表演者
senses.example: The pop star waved to the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 那位流行巨星向人群挥手。
senses.why: The performer rises above others like a light in the dark sky.
senses.whyCN: 表演者如夜空中的光点般高出于众人。

senses.title: A mark of quality or rank
senses.definition: a star-shaped sign showing quality, rank, or importance
senses.definitionCN: 表示质量、等级或重要性的星形标记
senses.example: The restaurant earned its third star last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家餐厅去年摘得第三颗星。
senses.why: The sky's five-point shape becomes the mark of the best.
senses.whyCN: 天空的星形被用作「最优」的标记。

senses.title: A person's fate shown in the sky
senses.definition: the supposed influence of stars on a person's fortune
senses.definitionCN: 传统上认为星辰对人的命运的影响
senses.example: Thank your lucky stars the storm passed.
senses.exampleCN: 感谢幸运之星让风暴过去了。
senses.why: Ancient people read futures in the fixed lights above.
senses.whyCN: 古人从头顶的固定光点里读出未来。

senses.title: To have someone as the main performer
senses.definition: to have a famous person as the main performer of a film or show
senses.definitionCN: 以某名人为影视或演出的主角
senses.example: The film stars a newcomer from Scotland.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影由一位苏格兰新人主演。
senses.why: The star name is fixed above the others on the poster.
senses.whyCN: 明星的名字被固定在海报上众人之首。

senses.title: A tiny star-shaped mark in writing
senses.definition: the small asterisk sign used to note something or rate items
senses.definitionCN: 用于注释或评分的小星号
senses.example: Give each answer one to five stars.
senses.exampleCN: 给每个答案打一到五星。
senses.why: The sign borrows the sky's shape for a tiny printed purpose.
senses.whyCN: 星号借用天上的形状做小小的印刷记号。

intro.en: Star is one of the oldest words in the language, going straight back to a root that meant to strew, as stars seem strewn across the night sky.
intro.cn: star 是语言中最古老的词之一，直溯一个意为「撒布」的词根——星星仿佛被撒满夜空。

items.en: The root *ster-, "to strew", is generally reconstructed; the exact ending is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为词根 *ster- 意为「撒布」；确切词尾来源不确定。

items.en: Germanic built stern and starra from the old root.
items.cn: 日耳曼语由古词根构成 stern 与 starra。

items.en: Old English steorra named the fixed lights of the night sky.
items.cn: 古英语 steorra 指夜空的固定光点。

items.en: Greek aster and Latin stella are cousins, giving asterisk and constellation.
items.cn: 希腊语 aster 与拉丁语 stella 是近亲，给出 asterisk 与 constellation。

items.en: The fame sense arose in the 19th century theater world.
items.cn: 「明星」义于十九世纪戏剧界兴起。

note.en: Star sits atop a wide sky-word family from Greek and Latin, and sounds like the unrelated starve.
note.cn: star 领衔源自希腊与拉丁的天空词族，并与不相关的 starve 音近。

normal.cn: star、starry、starlet：一个小词点亮一族。

normal.en: Movie stars were called stars because their names burned on posters.

normal.cn: star 与 starve 一字之差：光明与饥饿。

abstract.en: Lie back on summer grass and watch the sky sprinkle lights.
abstract.cn: 躺在夏夜草地上，看天空洒落光点。

abstract.en: See one name in giant letters glowing over a theater door.
abstract.cn: 看见剧院门上方巨字发光的明星名字。

abstract.en: Imagine a gold star pressed onto a perfect homework page.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗金星贴在满分的作业页上。

examples.cn: 一颗孤星低悬在海上。

examples.en: The new film stars two young actors from Ireland.
examples.cn: 这部新片由两位爱尔兰年轻演员主演。

examples.en: She gave the performance five stars.
examples.cn: 她给这场演出打了五星。

branches.cn: 指引方向并昭示命运的天上光点

items.exampleCN: 她奉献了一场精彩演出。

definition_zh: 凝视；盯着看；注视
definition_en: to look at something or someone for a long time with fixed eyes, without moving
core_image: 目光钉在一个点上——瞳孔不动，时间也不动
scene: 玻璃柜里的宝石在灯下闪着冷光。The boy stared at the diamond ring without blinking.
sceneCN: 这里 stare 是「凝视」（第 1 个义项：长时间定睛注视）；句意为男孩目不转睛地盯着那枚钻戒。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ing 构成，义为「凝视（行为）」
拉丁借语，由 stare 加 decisis 构成，义为「遵循先例（法律原则）」

senses.title: To look long with fixed eyes
senses.definition: to look steadily for a long time, often without realizing it
senses.definitionCN: 长时间定睛注视，常是不自觉的
senses.example: He stared at the dark screen, thinking.
senses.exampleCN: 他盯着黑屏出神地想。
senses.why: The eyes are nailed to one point; nothing else moves.
senses.whyCN: 双眼被钉在一点上，其余一切静止。

senses.title: To look in a fixed way at nothing
senses.definition: to look straight ahead with an empty mind
senses.definitionCN: 目光直视前方而心不在焉
senses.example: She stared into space during the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 开会时她望着远方发呆。
senses.why: The eyes hold still even when the mind has left.
senses.whyCN: 心已走远，目光却仍停驻。

senses.title: To look openly and rudely
senses.definition: to look at someone too long and too openly, causing discomfort
senses.definitionCN: 过长、过直地看人，令人不适
senses.example: It's rude to stare at strangers on the train.
senses.exampleCN: 在火车上盯着陌生人看很失礼。
senses.why: A gaze fixed too long presses on the person looked at.
senses.whyCN: 停驻过久的目光对被看者形成压迫。

senses.title: To show a long fixed look
senses.definition: a long look with unmoving eyes
senses.definitionCN: 目光不动的长久注视
senses.example: She answered his stare with a smile.
senses.exampleCN: 她以微笑回应他的注视。
senses.why: The act becomes a thing you can meet or return.
senses.whyCN: 动作成为可迎、可回的东西。

senses.title: To face something obviously
senses.definition: in stare someone or something in the face, to be plainly present and unavoidable
senses.definitionCN: stare in the face 中指显而易见、无法回避
senses.example: Danger stared them in the face all night.
senses.exampleCN: 危险整夜直逼他们眼前。
senses.why: The fact holds its position until you look back at it.
senses.whyCN: 事实站在原地不动，直到你不得不回望。

intro.en: Stare comes from Germanic words for a fixed, rigid gaze, sharing old roots with the word stark.
intro.cn: stare 来自日耳曼语「目光僵直」之词，与 stark 共享古老的词根。

items.en: A root meaning "rigid, stiff" is generally reconstructed; the link is usually accepted.
items.cn: 一般认为词根表示「僵硬、挺直」；此关联通常被接受。

items.en: Germanic stark meant stiff, and star- words named the fixed gaze.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 stark 意为僵直，star- 词族指僵直的目光。

items.en: Old English starian meant to stare or to be stiff.
items.cn: 古英语 starian 意为凝视或僵硬。

items.en: The noun stare and the rude-look nuance developed.
items.cn: 名词 stare 与「失礼凝视」的细微义发展。

items.en: Latin stare decisis, "to stand by decisions", borrowed the word into law.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stare decisis「遵循既立决定」把该词借入法律。

note.en: Stare is homophones with the stair of buildings, and cousins with the gaze family.

normal.cn: stare 与 stair 同音：去爬梯，别光盯着。

normal.cn: a blank stare：眼睁着，心走了。

normal.cn: stare someone down：目光钉住对方直到其眨眼。

abstract.en: Feel your eyes lock onto one point and forget the room.
abstract.cn: 感受目光锁住一点，忘了整个房间。

abstract.en: See a cat fixed on a mouse hole, unmoving.
abstract.cn: 看见猫一动不动盯住鼠洞。

abstract.en: Hear silence grow as two gazes hold each other.
abstract.cn: 听沉默在两道对视中生长。

examples.en: She stared at the letter, unable to speak.
examples.cn: 她盯着那封信，说不出话。

examples.en: Don't stare; it makes people uncomfortable.
examples.cn: 别盯着人看，那让人不舒服。

examples.en: The mountain stared down at the tiny village.
examples.cn: 高山俯瞰着小小的村庄。

branches.en: the look as a thing returned
branches.cn: 作为可回应之物的注视

branches.en: facts that hold their ground until seen
branches.cn: 站定不动逼人正视的事实

intro.en: Stare is a bare verb; its family grows by compounds with the eyes and the mind.
intro.cn: stare 是光杆动词；其词族围绕眼睛与心灵复合生长。

latinIntro.en: Latin stare "to stand" borrowed the shape for law Latin, but the English word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 stare「站立」被借入法律拉丁语；英语本词则属日耳曼语源。

items.example: Staring at screens all day tires the eyes.
items.exampleCN: 整天盯屏幕让眼睛疲劳。

items.example: He gave a blank stare at the question.
items.exampleCN: 他对问题报以茫然一瞥。

items.example: The stark truth was hard to hear.
items.exampleCN: 严酷的真相难以入耳。

items.meaning: to win a contest of looks
items.example: She stared down the heckler.
items.exampleCN: 她以目光压倒了起哄者。

items.example: He stared into space for a while.
items.exampleCN: 他望着虚空发了会儿呆。

items.example: They gazed at the harbor lights.
items.exampleCN: 他们凝望着港口的灯火。

items.example: Mind the top stair.
items.exampleCN: 当心最上面那级台阶。

items.example: The teacher's glare silenced the room.
items.exampleCN: 老师的怒视让全屋安静。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加-ing 构成，义为「凝视」

definition_zh: 开始；启动；出发；惊跳；起点；开办
definition_en: to begin something, to set out, to jump suddenly in surprise, or the first point of a process
core_image: 发动机钥匙拧动的瞬间——或被吓了一跳的猛然一动
scene: 清晨的跑道上，发令枪高高举起。The runners crouched low, waiting for the race to start.
sceneCN: 这里 start 是「开始」（第 1 个义项：赛事或行动的起点）；句意为选手们俯身低蹲，等待比赛开始。

pos.zh: 动词：开始；启动；出发；惊跳

derivatives.zh: 由本词加后缀构成，义为「使惊吓；使一惊」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「发起者；起动器；第一道菜」
由本词加 point 构成，义为「起点」

senses.title: To begin doing something
senses.definition: to begin an activity, work, or process
senses.definitionCN: 着手开始一项活动、工作或进程
senses.example: They started building the bridge in March.
senses.exampleCN: 他们三月开始建桥。
senses.why: A movement is set loose from stillness.
senses.whyCN: 运动从静止中被释放出来。

senses.title: To set an engine or machine working
senses.definition: to make an engine or machine begin working
senses.definitionCN: 使引擎或机器开始运转
senses.example: The engine started on the second try.
senses.exampleCN: 引擎第二次才发动起来。
senses.why: Still metal suddenly jumps into motion.
senses.whyCN: 静止的金属猛然进入运动。

senses.title: To jump suddenly in surprise
senses.definition: to move suddenly because of fear or surprise
senses.definitionCN: 因惊吓或意外而突然动作
senses.example: She started at the sound of the door.
senses.exampleCN: 听到门响她吓了一跳。
senses.why: A body at rest bursts into motion, exactly like an engine starting.
senses.whyCN: 静止的身体骤然一动，恰如引擎点火。

senses.title: To begin a journey
senses.definition: to leave a place to begin a journey
senses.definitionCN: 离开某地开始一段旅程
senses.example: We started out before sunrise.
senses.exampleCN: 日出前我们就动身了。
senses.why: The first step of a road is its beginning.
senses.whyCN: 道路的第一步就是它的开端。

senses.title: The first point of a race or process
senses.definition: the place or moment where something begins
senses.definitionCN: 某事开始的地方或时刻
senses.example: The start of the marathon is marked by a line.
senses.exampleCN: 马拉松的起点用一条线标出。
senses.why: The loose moment of motion is pinned to one line or time.
senses.whyCN: 运动释放的那一刻被钉在一条线或一个时刻上。

senses.title: An advantage given at the beginning
senses.definition: an advantage given or gained at the beginning of a contest
senses.definitionCN: 竞赛之初获得或给予的有利条件
senses.example: The young team got a strong start in the season.
senses.exampleCN: 年轻的队伍赛季开局强劲。
senses.why: Whoever moves loose first holds the lead.
senses.whyCN: 谁先动起来，谁就领先。

intro.en: Start originally meant to leap or jump up, and only later came to mean beginning — the jump came first.
intro.cn: start 本义是「跃起」，后来才有「开始」义——先有跳，后有始。

items.en: A root meaning "to move stiffly, tail" is generally reconstructed for the tail sense of Germanic; detail is source uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为日耳曼语「尾」义源自表示「僵直移动」的词根；细节来源不确定。

items.en: Germanic start- meant the tail, then the act of starting up.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 start- 先指尾巴，后指跃起。

items.en: Old English styrtan meant to leap up suddenly.
items.cn: 古英语 styrtan 意为突然跃起。

items.en: The sudden-jump sense widened to any sudden beginning.
items.cn: 「骤然一跳」扩展为「骤然开始」。

items.en: Engines, races, and businesses all borrowed the one jumping image.
items.cn: 引擎、赛道与企业都借用了这一个「跃起」意象。

note.en: Start shares family with startle and start, and sounds like the unrelated tart.
note.cn: start 与 startle 同族，并与不相关的 tart 音近。

entries.definition: an open pastry with fruit
entries.definitionCN: 水果馅饼；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: to make someone jump in surprise
entries.definitionCN: 使惊吓；与 start 同族

entries.definition: one who starts, or the first course
entries.definitionCN: 发起者；开胃菜；由 start 派生

entries.definition: to start doing something
to begin formally
to set something new in motion
to draw back suddenly in fear

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for start and its jumps.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 start 的诸般「跃起」。

normal.en: start and startle share the jump: one begins, one makes you jump.
normal.cn: start 与 startle 同源：一个开始，一个令你惊跳。

normal.en: startle = start + -le, the frequent jump maker.
normal.cn: startle = start + -le，使你屡屡「跳起」的后缀。

normal.en: a head start: you jump before the others.
normal.cn: a head start：比别人先跳。

normal.en: start the car: metal leaps into motion.
normal.cn: start the car：钢铁一跃而起。

normal.en: from start to finish: from the first jump to the last step.
normal.cn: from start to finish：从第一次跃起到最后一步。

abstract.en: See a cat leap sideways at a sudden noise.
abstract.cn: 看见猫被突如其来的声响吓得侧身跃起。

abstract.en: Hear a cold engine catch and roar to life.
abstract.cn: 听冷引擎着火、轰然转动。

abstract.en: Feel your foot leave the line as the gun cracks.
abstract.cn: 感受枪响瞬间脚尖离线。

examples.en: The meeting started ten minutes late.
examples.cn: 会议晚开始十分钟。

examples.en: He started the old tractor with one pull.
examples.cn: 他一拉就把旧拖拉机发动了。

examples.en: Every journey starts with a single step.
examples.cn: 千里之行始于足下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯达特」——像「死蹬它」：一脚死蹬下去，人车同时启动。

root: 古英语 styrtan「跃起」，属日耳曼语源，startle 为同族派生；一般认为与表示「僵直移动、尾」的词根相关（尾巴说为通常看法），确切印欧形式来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: One sudden jump becomes the beginning of races, journeys, engines, and businesses.
sensesIntro.cn: 一次骤然跃起化作比赛、旅程、引擎与事业的开端。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stillness bursting suddenly into motion
core.cn: 核心意象：静止骤然爆裂为运动

branches.en: works and engines set loose
branches.cn: 被释放启动的工作与引擎

branches.en: the body's own sudden jump
the road's first step
the pinned first point
the lead held from the first jump

intro.en: Start builds a busy little family of jumpers and starters.
intro.cn: start 构建了一个忙碌的小词族：跃起者与启动者。

latinIntro.en: Start is Germanic; there are no Latin relatives, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: start 属日耳曼语源；无拉丁同族词，拉丁列表为空。

items.meaning: to make jump repeatedly or easily, as in startle
items.example: The loud clap startled the pigeons.
items.exampleCN: 响亮的拍手惊飞了鸽子。

items.meaning: one who or thing that starts
items.example: The starter motor failed again.
items.exampleCN: 起动马达又坏了。

items.example: Hard work gave her a head start.
items.exampleCN: 勤奋给了她先发优势。

items.example: They started up the old mill.
items.exampleCN: 他们让老磨坊重新运转。

items.example: Let's start over from page one.
items.exampleCN: 我们从第一页重新开始。

items.example: The firm started out with two workers.
items.exampleCN: 这家公司起初只有两名员工。

items.example: The village is the starting point of the trail.
items.exampleCN: 这个村子是步道的起点。

items.meaning: a fresh start, a clean new beginning
items.example: Moving abroad gave her a fresh start.
items.exampleCN: 移居国外给了她全新的开始。

由本词加 -er 构成，义为「发起者；起动器」

definition_zh: 陈述；声明；说法；报表；结单
definition_en: something said or written that gives information, or an official report of money or facts
core_image: 一方印着字的纸从机构窗口递出——白纸黑字，字字可查
scene: 月底，银行信件准时寄到家里。The bank statement showed every payment she had made that month.
sceneCN: 这里 statement 是「对账单；结单」（第 4 个义项：机构出具的正式报表）；句意为银行对账单列出了她当月的每一笔支出。

derivatives.zh: 本词的动词基础，义为「陈述；说明」
由本词加-ed 构成，义为「获正式教育评估的（英国特殊教育用语）」
由 mis- 加本词构成，义为「错误陈述」

senses.title: Something said or written that gives information
senses.definition: a sentence or set of words giving information or an opinion
senses.definitionCN: 给出信息或观点的句子或词组
senses.example: The report contains several questionable statements.
senses.exampleCN: 报告里有几处可疑的表述。
senses.why: Facts are set out in words, fixed like lines on a page.
senses.whyCN: 事实以文字陈列，如纸上固定的行列。

senses.title: An official public announcement
senses.definition: a formal announcement made to the public or press
senses.definitionCN: 面向公众或媒体的正式公告
senses.example: The company issued a statement about the safety recall.
senses.exampleCN: 公司就安全召回发布了声明。
senses.why: The institution sets its words in an official frame.
senses.whyCN: 机构把自己的话放进正式的框里。

senses.title: An expression of attitude through dress or action
senses.definition: clothes, art, or actions that declare a personal stance
senses.definitionCN: 借服装、艺术或行动宣示个人立场
senses.example: Her bright red coat was a real fashion statement.
senses.exampleCN: 她那件鲜红大衣真是一场时尚宣言。
senses.why: What you wear is read like written words.
senses.whyCN: 你的穿着如文字般被解读。

senses.title: An official report of money or facts
senses.definition: a printed record of money movements, sales, or facts over a period
senses.definitionCN: 一段时间内资金流动、销售或事实的打印记录
senses.example: Check your statement before paying the bill.
senses.exampleCN: 付账前先核对一下对账单。
senses.why: Numbers, like words, are set out in an official list.
senses.whyCN: 数字与文字一样被陈列在正式单据上。

senses.title: A formal sentence in logic or law
senses.definition: a sentence that can be judged true or false in logic, or a formal account in law
senses.definitionCN: 逻辑中可判定真假的句子，或法律中的正式陈述
senses.example: In logic, every statement is either true or false.
senses.exampleCN: 在逻辑学中，每个命题非真即假。
senses.why: The sentence is fixed in a frame where truth can be tested.
senses.whyCN: 句子被固定在可检验真假的框架里。

intro.en: Statement is state plus -ment: words that are set out in a fixed, official form.
intro.cn: statement 即 state 加 -ment：以固定、正式形式陈列的话语。

items.en: The stand-root *sta- underlies state and statement.
items.cn: 「站立」词根 *sta- 是 state 与 statement 的基础。

items.en: Latin stare grew into state via Old French estat, meaning a standing condition.
items.cn: 拉丁 stare 经古法语 estat 长出 state，意为「站立的状态」。

items.en: The verb state, "to set out in words", formed in English.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语形成动词 state「以文字陈明」。

items.en: Adding -ment gave statement: the words so set out.
items.cn: 加 -ment 构成 statement：如此陈明的言语。

items.en: Bank statements, official statements, and fashion statements spread the noun widely.
items.cn: 银行结单、官方声明与时尚宣言让该名词广泛传播。

note.en: Statement grows from the stand-root family and pairs with the say-family of announcement words.
note.cn: statement 由「站立」词族长出，并与「言说」词族的公告类词配对。

entries.definition: a condition, a country, or the verb to say formally
entries.definitionCN: 状态；国家；陈述；statement 的词基

entries.definition: a wrong statement
entries.definitionCN: 错误陈述；由 mis- 加本词

entries.definition: a written law
entries.definitionCN: 成文法；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: a public notice of news
a formal and public statement

entries.definitionCN: 随口评论；与正式声明相对

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for statement and its state-root.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 statement 及其 state 词根。

normal.en: state + -ment: the words formally set out.
normal.cn: state + -ment：正式陈明的话语。

normal.en: a bank statement: money set out line by line.
normal.cn: bank statement：资金逐行陈列。

normal.en: make a statement: clothes can talk too.
normal.cn: make a statement：衣着也会说话。

normal.en: misstatement: the wrong words were set out.
normal.cn: misstatement：陈明错了的话。

normal.en: state and statement share the old stand-root.
normal.cn: state 与 statement 共享古老的「站立」词根。

abstract.en: See a sealed envelope marked OFFICIAL STATEMENT.
abstract.cn: 看见封口盖着 OFFICIAL STATEMENT 的信封。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger page ruled with straight lines.
abstract.cn: 想象一页划满直线的账册。

abstract.en: Hear a spokesperson read calm words to the cameras.
abstract.cn: 听发言人面对镜头平静宣读。

examples.en: Her statement to the police was short and clear.
examples.cn: 她对警方的陈述简短清晰。

examples.en: The painting makes a bold statement about war.
examples.cn: 这幅画对战争作出了大胆的表述。

examples.en: The monthly statement arrives by email now.
examples.cn: 月度结单如今通过电子邮件送达。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯得特门特」——像「死白的门特」：白纸黑字，从门里递出的正式文书。

root: statement 由动词 state「陈明」加名词后缀 -ment 构成；state 经古法语 estat 上溯拉丁 stare「站立」，属「站立」词族。

sensesIntro.en: Statement is words set out in a fixed frame: said, published, worn, printed, or tested for truth.
sensesIntro.cn: statement 是被固定框定后陈列的话语：说出、发布、穿上、打印或接受真伪检验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: words fixed into a formal frame and set out
core.cn: 核心意象：话语被固定进正式框架后陈列

branches.en: words judged by what they claim
branches.cn: 据所言内容接受评判的话语

branches.en: the institution's public words
clothes and acts that read like words
branches.cn: 如文字般被解读的衣着与行动

branches.en: numbers set out like words
the plain information sense

intro.en: Statement is state with a suffix that turns action into a thing.
intro.cn: statement 是 state 加上把动作转为名词的后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin stare, from the stand-root, is the deep base of state and statement.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 stare 出自「站立」词根，是 state 与 statement 的深层基础。

items.example: The minister stated her position clearly.
items.exampleCN: 部长清晰陈述了立场。

items.meaning: the thing produced by the action
items.example: Agreement and statement both end in -ment.
items.exampleCN: agreement 与 statement 都以 -ment 结尾。

items.example: The audit found a misstatement of costs.
items.exampleCN: 审计发现成本陈述有误。

items.meaning: given a formal record, as in education
items.example: A statemented child receives extra support.
items.exampleCN: 获正式评估的儿童可获额外支持。

items.example: Her bank statement arrived on the first.
items.exampleCN: 她的银行结单一号到达。

items.example: Oversized glasses are a fashion statement.
items.exampleCN: 超大眼镜是一种时尚宣言。

items.example: An official statement followed the accident.
items.exampleCN: 事故之后发布了官方声明。

items.example: Latin stare is the deep root of state.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁 stare 是 state 的深层词根。

definition_zh: 车站；站；所；局；驻地；电视台；派驻；安置
definition_en: a place where a service stops and works, such as a railway stop, a police base, or a broadcasting office
core_image: 一方固定的驻点——火车在此停驻，警察在此坐镇，电波从此发出
scene: 傍晚的站台上，路灯次第亮起。We said goodbye on the platform of the small country station.
sceneCN: 这里 station 是「车站」（第 1 个义项：火车停靠的场所）；句意为我们在小乡站的月台上道别。

derivatives.zh: 与本词同根，义为「静止的；不动的」
与本词同根，义为「文具（原指在固定地点出售）」
由 way 加本词构成，义为「中途站」

senses.title: A place where trains stop
senses.definition: a place with platforms where trains stop for passengers
senses.definitionCN: 设有月台、供列车停靠载客的场所
senses.example: The train pulls into the station at seven.
senses.exampleCN: 火车七点进站。
senses.why: The stop where trains stand fixed for a while.
senses.whyCN: 列车停驻片刻的固定之点。

senses.title: A base for a service
senses.definition: the building where a police, fire, or medical service works
senses.definitionCN: 警察、消防或医疗服务的驻地建筑
senses.example: Report the theft at the nearest police station.
senses.exampleCN: 请到最近的警察局报案。
senses.why: The service sits fixed in one building, like a train at its stop.
senses.whyCN: 服务机构固定坐镇一栋建筑，如列车停靠其站。

senses.title: A broadcasting office
senses.definition: a company or place that sends out radio or television programs
senses.definitionCN: 播送广播或电视节目的机构或场所
senses.example: The local station filmed the festival all day.
senses.exampleCN: 当地电视台全天拍摄了庆典。
senses.why: Waves are sent out from one fixed point.
senses.whyCN: 电波从一个固定之点发出。

senses.title: A fixed post of duty
senses.definition: the fixed place or duty where a person or ship serves
senses.definitionCN: 人员或舰船服役的固定地点或岗位
senses.example: The sailors rushed to their battle stations.
senses.exampleCN: 水兵们迅速奔向各自的战斗岗位。
senses.why: The stand-root at its most literal: the spot where you stand.
senses.whyCN: 「站立」词根最字面的呈现：你站立的地点。

senses.title: A place with equipment for one purpose
senses.definition: a place built for one purpose, such as research or fuel
senses.definitionCN: 为科研、加油等单一目的而设的场所
senses.example: The research station sits on the polar ice.
senses.exampleCN: 科考站坐落在极地冰原上。
senses.why: People and tools stand fixed where the work demands.
senses.whyCN: 人立于工具所在之处，工作要求便在那里。

senses.title: To send a person to a fixed post
senses.definition: to send someone to a place for duty and keep them there
senses.definitionCN: 派人前往某地执行任务并令其驻留
senses.example: Guards were stationed at every gate.
senses.exampleCN: 每个大门都派了卫兵驻守。
senses.why: The noun of place becomes the act of placing.
senses.whyCN: 地点名词化作安置的动作。

intro.en: Station is pure Latin stand-root: from stare "to stand" through stare per annum "to stand firm for the year", to a fixed post or stop.
intro.cn: station 是纯粹的拉丁「站立」词根：由 stare「站立」经 stare per annum「常年驻守」到固定的驻点或停靠处。

items.en: The root *sta-, "to stand", is the base.
items.cn: 词根 *sta-「站立」为词之基础。

items.en: Latin statio meant a standing still, a post, or a watch.
items.cn: 拉丁语 statio 意为站立不动、驻点或哨位。

items.en: Old French station entered English in the 13th century as a fixed post or duty.
items.cn: 十三世纪经古法语进入英语，指固定的岗位或职守。

items.en: Railway stations, police stations, and stations of the cross spread the stop sense.
items.cn: 火车站、警察局与苦路十四站扩展了「停靠」义。

items.en: Radio stations, space stations, and the verb to station completed the range.
items.cn: 电台、空间站与动词「派驻」完成词义版图。

note.en: Station heads the stand-root family of fixed places and stands beside its cousins state and status.
note.cn: station 领衔「站立」词族的固定场所词群，与近亲 state、status 并立。

normalIntro.en: Five real hooks for station and its twins.
normalIntro.cn: 五条真实钩子帮助记住 station 与它的孪生词。

normal.en: station, stationary, stationery: one root, two spellings, three lives.
normal.cn: station、stationary、stationery：同根、两种拼写、三种人生。

normal.en: A station is where things stand: trains, police, radio waves.
normal.cn: station 是「站立之所」：列车、警察、电波。

normal.en: battle stations: the place where you stand in battle.
normal.cn: battle stations：战斗中你该站的位置。

normal.en: stationed abroad: fixed there for duty.
normal.cn: stationed abroad：因任务驻留他国。

normal.en: space station: a home that stands in the sky.
normal.cn: space station：立于天上的家。

abstract.en: Hear the echo of a hall where trains come to rest.
abstract.cn: 听列车归站时大厅的回声。

abstract.en: See a guard posted at the gate, motionless.
abstract.cn: 看见卫兵钉在大门旁，纹丝不动。

abstract.en: Picture waves leaving one tall antenna night after night.
abstract.cn: 想象电波夜复一夜离开同一根高塔天线。

examples.en: Meet me at the central station at noon.
examples.cn: 中午在中央车站见。

examples.en: The ship was stationed off the northern coast.
examples.cn: 该舰被派驻在北部海岸外海。

examples.en: The weather station reports the temperature every hour.
examples.cn: 气象站每小时报告一次气温。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯戴申」——像「死钉身」：把人和车死钉在一个地点，站住不动。

root: 拉丁 statio「驻点、哨位」出自 stare「站立」，经古法语 station 于十三世纪进入英语；属「站立」词根（*sta-）族。

sensesIntro.en: One standing post becomes a train stop, a police base, a radio office, and the act of posting people there.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个站立驻点化作列车站、警察局、电台，以及把人派驻其间的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fixed spot where something stands to serve
core.cn: 核心意象：供某物驻立服务之固定地点

branches.en: places where trains, science, and fuel stand
branches.cn: 列车、科考与燃料驻立之处

branches.en: services and sailors fixed at their posts
branches.cn: 坐镇于岗位的服务与水兵

intro.en: Station is statio with an English face; its cousins wear -ary and -ery.
intro.cn: station 是 statio 的英语面孔；其近亲披着 -ary 与 -ery。

latinIntro.en: Latin stare "to stand" is the deep root; statio is its place-form.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 stare「站立」为深层词根；statio 是其地点形态。

items.meaning: the act or place of standing
items.example: Station and station both end in -tion.
items.exampleCN: station 之类名词以 -tion 收尾。

items.example: A stationary car blocked the lane.
items.exampleCN: 一辆停着的车堵住了车道。

items.meaning: the goods of a fixed shop
items.example: She bought stationery for school.
items.exampleCN: 她买了开学文具。

items.example: The space station circles every 90 minutes.
items.exampleCN: 空间站每 90 分钟绕行一周。

items.meaning: the base of a police force
items.example: He reported the crime at the police station.
items.exampleCN: 他到警察局报了案。

items.meaning: a place where fuel is sold
items.example: Stop at a gas station before the desert road.
items.exampleCN: 走沙漠公路前先在加油站停一下。

items.example: Latin statio named a guard's fixed post.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁 statio 指哨兵的固定岗位。

items.example: His status in the firm rose quickly.
items.exampleCN: 他在公司的地位迅速上升。

definition_zh: 停留；暂住；保持；坚持；逗留；支柱
definition_en: to remain in a place or condition, or a period of living somewhere, or a rope that holds something firm
core_image: 双脚站在原地不走——身体、情绪与绳索都稳稳保持原状
scene: 旅馆大堂的挂钟指向九点。They decided to stay another night because the storm kept falling.
sceneCN: 这里 stay 是「暂住；多留」（第 1 个义项：继续停留某处）；句意为他们决定再住一晚，因为暴风雪未停。

pos.zh: 名词：逗留；暂住；支柱；（法律）中止

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -er 构成，义为「留下来的人；坚持到底者」
由本词构成的传统复数，义为「（旧式）紧身胸衣的撑条」

senses.title: To remain in a place
senses.definition: to remain somewhere instead of leaving, or to live somewhere for a while
senses.definitionCN: 留在某处不离开，或小住一段时间
senses.example: We stayed with friends by the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 我们暂住在湖边朋友家。
senses.why: The feet stand fixed where they are.
senses.whyCN: 双脚钉在原地不动。

senses.title: To remain in a condition
senses.definition: to continue in a certain state or quality
senses.definitionCN: 继续处于某种状态或品质
senses.example: Keep the soup on a low heat so it stays warm.
senses.exampleCN: 汤用小火煨着，保持温热。
senses.why: What stands still keeps its shape.
senses.whyCN: 静止不动的东西保持原形。

senses.title: To hold firmly in position
senses.definition: to keep something firm or in place, especially a rope or brace
senses.definitionCN: 使某物稳固或就位，尤指缆索或撑杆
senses.example: The mast is stayed by strong steel ropes.
senses.exampleCN: 桅杆由坚固的钢索固定。
senses.why: The oldest nautical sense: ropes that let the mast stand.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的航海义：让桅杆立住的缆索。

senses.title: A period of remaining somewhere
senses.definition: the time spent living or being in a place
senses.definitionCN: 在某处居住或停留的时间
senses.example: Enjoy your stay in the capital!
senses.exampleCN: 祝你在首都逗留愉快！
senses.why: The fixed standing time becomes a countable visit.
senses.whyCN: 驻立的时段成为可数的到访。

senses.title: A legal pause of action
senses.definition: a court order stopping a legal process for a time
senses.definitionCN: 法院暂时中止法律程序的命令
senses.example: The judge granted a stay of the proceedings.
senses.exampleCN: 法官批准中止诉讼程序。
senses.why: The process stands still, held where it is.
senses.whyCN: 程序被按在原地停驻。

senses.title: A rope or brace holding something upright
senses.definition: a strong rope or rod that keeps a mast or structure upright
senses.definitionCN: 使桅杆或构筑物保持直立的缆索或撑杆
senses.example: One of the ship's stays snapped in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 狂风中船上一根拉索崩断。
senses.why: The sense-3 rope, used as a noun for the thing itself.
senses.whyCN: 第三义之绳转作名词，指绳本身。

intro.en: Stay grew from old Germanic and French roots about standing still: first ropes that let a mast stand, then every kind of remaining.
intro.cn: stay 由古老词根「站立不动」生长：先是指让桅杆立住的绳索，后指一切停留。

items.en: The root *sta-, "to stand", is shared with stable and stand.
items.cn: 词根 *sta-「站立」与 stable、stand 共享。

items.en: Old French estayer, from a Germanic root for "to prop", meant to support; two streams met in English.
items.cn: 古法语 estayer（源自日耳曼「支撑」词根）意为支撑；两支源流在英语汇合。

items.en: Nautical stays and the sense of halting both appear early.
items.cn: 航海的拉索义与「止住」义均早期出现。

items.en: The sense of remaining in a place or state settled.
items.cn: 「停留在某地或某状态」之义定型。

items.en: Legal stays, hotel stays, and stay calm fixed the everyday range.
items.cn: 法律中止、旅馆住宿与保持冷静定形于现代用法。

note.en: Stay belongs to the great stand-family and is often confused with its own spelling twin steady.
note.cn: stay 属庞大的「站立」词族，并常与其拼写近亲 steady 混淆。

normal.en: stay and steady share the stand-root: both mean fixed.
normal.cn: stay 与 steady 同根：都指钉定不动。

normal.en: stay up late: your body stays out of bed.
normal.cn: stay up late：身体留在床外。

normal.en: Boat masts stand because of stays.

normal.en: stay calm: your feelings keep their standing.
normal.cn: stay calm：情绪保持原位。

normal.en: a stay of execution: the law makes time stand still.

abstract.en: Feel your feet refusing the open door.

abstract.en: See soup holding its warm stillness on the stove.
abstract.cn: 看见炉上的汤保持着温热的静止。

abstract.en: Watch ropes hold a tall mast against the wind.
abstract.cn: 看缆索顶住风势稳住高桅。

examples.en: Stay where you are until help arrives.
examples.cn: 待在原地等待救援。

examples.en: The soup stayed warm for hours in the pot.
examples.cn: 汤在锅里保温了好几个小时。

examples.en: Their stay in Paris lasted only two days.
examples.cn: 他们在巴黎的逗留只有两天。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯得」——像「死等」：死等不走，站在原地到天亮。

root: 一般认为 stay 由两支源流汇合：古法语 estayer「支撑」（日耳曼词根）与表示「站立」的 *sta- 词族（与 stable、stand 同源）；航海拉索义最古老。

sensesIntro.en: One standing still grows into ropes that hold, periods of living somewhere, and laws that freeze time.
sensesIntro.cn: 一次站立不动长成稳住万物的绳索、异地小住的时光与冻结时间的法令。
